name: Stonecrest Sparrow
flavor: Though easy to hear from a great distance, climbing to the heights in which the stonecrest sparrow roosts, in sound-shattered nooks along cliff faces, is the much more difficult task. Setting traps along pock-marked stone walls though is a sure way to patiently catch this skittish little bird, as a direct confrontation can lead to a ruptured ear drum at best.

traits.name: Keen Eyes
traits.desc: The stonecrest sparrow has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) Checks that rely on sight.

traits.name: Flutter Flight
traits.desc: The stonecrest sparrow doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

defensive_instinct: If it survives any attempt at being attacked. On its turn, Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 11, the stonecrest sparrow. Success: The stonecrest sparrow Shattering Chirp Attack is automatically recharged and it makes that attack as a Bonus Action if there is an enemy creature within range.

actions.name: Peck
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit : 4 (1d4 +2) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Shattering Chirp
actions.desc: (Recharge 5-6) Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12, each creature in a 15 ft. cone. Failure: 9 (1d10 + 4) Thunder damage and the target creature has the deafened Condition for 1 minute. Success: Half damage.

reactions.name: Nimble Wings
reactions.desc: Trigger: A creature the stonecrest sparrow can see hits it with an attack roll. Response - Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 13, the triggering creature. Failure: The attack misses instead.

name: Gharril
flavor: As the tide recedes, a large shell rises out of a tidal pool, a single orange eye peering across the receding waves, searching for the flopping desperation of stranded fi sh. Suddenly, a tail whips salt water into the air and with loping limbs the large snail strides across the sands. Quickly, out pacing competing crustaceans, it grasps the fi sh with its four prehensile tentacles, pulling the live prey in and grinding flesh and bone whole into its fearsome maw. Over time, gharril slowly build up a pearl of sorts in their gullet, a rolled and compressed sphere of bone and chitin from their coastal feasting. When threatened by a larger predator, they can expel this organic cannonball with devastating velocity, shattering bone and shell alike.

bio.niche: Amphibious Generalist Omnivore Preyed upon by Cerrophol, Daellash, Illithisk, Slannethiss · Preys on Daugon, Lanceleth, Scavick, Vinnirex

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: A gharril can breathe both air and water.

traits.name: Coral Shelled
traits.desc: When a gharril's lower body is buried and remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a coral outcropping. It has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to Hide while in the Strands biome or coastal-like environments.

defensive_instinct: If it survives any attempt at being attacked for the fi rst time the gharril will attempt to bury its more vulnerable soft flesh in the sand. On its turn, the gharril lowers its movement speed to 0 ft., loses its Vulnerability to Cold and gains +2 AC (total 17). It can choose to return to its normal state as a Bonus action.

actions.name: Mauling Tentacles
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6+3) Bludgeoning damage. Strength Saving Th row: DC 14, one Medium or smaller creature the gharril has successfully hit. Failure: Th e target has the Grappled condition (Escape DC 14) .

actions.name: Bone Pearl (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll : +3 to hit, reach 40 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (3d6+1) Bludgeoning damage. Strength Saving Th row: DC 16, one Medium or smaller creature the gharril has successful hit. Failure: Th e target has the Prone condition .

name: Illithisk
flavor: Rising from the surf, salt water streams off odd squirming maggot-like pillars, with a strong paddle-like tail, the illithisk bursts out of the shallow tide. Scythe-like claws extended and grabs at a nearby vinnirex, a pained bark cut short by the mandibles biting deep into its fur. Within a heart beat of the flailing beast, paralyzing toxins built up over time by the symbiotic host of urchin on its back quickly silences the canine as the crustacean drags it under the waves. Although they are often the prey for larger predators, both from land and sea, this crustacean has an edge over the other diminutive scavengers that plague the beaches by the use of processing a toxin from the symbiotic urchin on its back, able to take down creatures that would otherwise crush its feeble form.

bio.niche: Amphibious Generalist Carnivore Preyed upon by Daellash, Slannethiss, Vortautilus · Preys on Daugon, Gharril, Rauka, Vinnirex

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: Th e illithisk can breathe both air and water.

traits.name: Tidal Stalker
traits.desc: Th e illithisk has Advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has Surprised.

defensive_instinct: When the illithisk is engaged in combat and Bloodied, spores violently expel from the urchin pillars along its back. On its turn, Constitution Saving Th row: DC 11, each creature in a 5 ft. Emanation originating from the illithisk. Failure: 5 (2d4) Poison damage, has the Paralyzed condition and can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute it succeeds automatically. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Scything Claw
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll : +5 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. Hit : 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage. Strength Saving Th row: DC 12, one Medium or smaller creature that the illithisk has successfully hit. Failure: Th e target has the Grapple condition (Escape DC 12) . Th e illithisk can only Grapple one creature at a time.

actions.name: Paralytic Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll : +5 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. Hit : 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage. Constitution Saving Th row: DC 11, target creature the illithisk has successfully hit. Failure: 5 (2d4) Poison damage and has the Paralyzed condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute it succeeds automatically. Success: Half Damage.

name: Trawlauth
flavor: Trudging through the coastal shallows, the trawlauth looks to be merely the head of a thick trailing fog that drowns out all life behind it. When in reality, it is performing a vital service to the ocean floor by scraping off the virulent oxygen sucking algae and clearing space for new plant and coral growth. Th rough symbiotic mutualism the trawlauth is host to a colony of bacteria that resides on and under its exoskeleton. Living off the excrement of the crustacean and leaching calcium from its shell, the bacteria builds up funnels along the back of the creature. Th rough these, it vents a viscous bacterial soup that billows out into the water in thick, gill-choking clouds that protects the trawlauth from any nearby predators while spreading its bacterial spores far and wide.

bio.niche: Specialist Marine Algivore Preyed upon by Cerrophol, Lanceleth, Goliarch, Vinnirex

name: Cerrophol
flavor: As the tide falls, exposing trapped crustaceans and fish within tidal pools, the cerrophol stalks out of the surf to survey the pickings. Though resembling an octopus, this semi-terrestrial squid uses its two feeding tentacles to hunt above the waves. Through the selective pressures of evolution, they have hardened into claw-like tips for dragging its body across stone and sand, as well as cracking urchin and crab shell that it hunts for with its forward facing predatory eyes. With enough salt water held in its mantle for short trips upon the sand, the creature can make use of the often trapped prey in this alternating environment. Unfortunately for this squid, many other predators along Sol'Kesh coasts have adapted to this same tidal ecosystem strategy, and the competition to thrive is fierce.

bio.niche: Amphibious Generalist Carnivore Preyed upon by Daellash, Gharril, Goliarch, Illithisk, Slannethiss, Vinnirex · Preys on Daugon, Gharril, Illithisk

traits.name: Coastal Hunter
traits.desc: The cerrophol can breathe only water, and while out of water, it can hold its breath for 1 hour.

traits.name: Polarized Sight
traits.desc: The cerrophol has Advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks to determine if a creature is being deceptive about its appearance, whether through magical or mundane means.

traits.name: Twisting Form
traits.desc: The cerrophol writing tentacles makes the squid difficult to grasp, it has Advantage on Saving Throws made to escape the Grappled condition.

traits.name: Aggressive Instinct
traits.desc: (1/Day) When Bloodied and engaged in melee combat, the cerrophol begins to flail wildly. On its turn, Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 12, the cerrophol. Success: The cerrophol gains a third attack for its Multiattack action. Failure: The cerrophol is overcome with fear and makes a free Disengage and Dash action in any direction away from adversaries.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The cerrophol makes two attacks, using Piercing Tentacles and Gripping Arms in any combination.

actions.name: Piercing Tentacles
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8+3) Piercing damage. Until the start of the cerrophol's next turn, attack rolls made against the same target creature are made with Advantage.

actions.name: Gripping Arms
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6+3) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (Escape DC 15) from one of its eight arms.

reactions.name: Ink Spill
reactions.desc: (1/Day) Trigger: The cerrophol takes damage while out of the water. Response: It releases a 15 ft. radius puddle of slippery ink centered on its body. The area becomes difficult terrain for 1 minute. Any creature that moves on the ink must make a DC 14 Dexterity Saving Throw or get the Prone condition. The ink can be washed away with at least 2 gallons of water.

name: Daellash
flavor: From deep within limestone tunnels to vast interwoven coral caverns, the daellash worms its way through tight confines and hidden pathways, snapping up a multitude of crustaceans and fish that crowd those submerged waterways. Extending long filament gills, the daellash can weave them through the cramped spaces, allowing the large eel to breathe, all the while pushing deeper into the stony depths for new crevices to explore. Unlike its younger form, the adult exchanges group ambush strategies for a long ranged solitary hunting, ever vigilant for new nooks and crannies to corner prey. These wildly successful large eels are found especially within Dawnsreach, its long powerful body so perfectly adapted to the twisted weaving coral that many believe the species originated there before spreading outwards to dominate the rest of Sol'Kesh's coastline.

bio.niche: Generalist Marine Carnivore Preyed upon by Goliarch, Slannethiss, Spiera, Vortautilus · Preys on Cerrophol, Esslinter, Illithisk, Tiama

traits.name: Saturated Gill Branches
traits.desc: The daellash can breathe only underwater, and can survive without oxygen for 30 minutes.

traits.name: Serpentine Form
traits.desc: The daellash has Advantage on Saving Throws made to escape a Grapple.

traits.name: Wary Instinct
traits.desc: (1/Day) When the daellash is currently swallowing a creature it soon looks for an escape. On its turn, Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 10, the daellash. Success: The daellash takes the Disengage action and flees. Attempting to swim into any deep tunnel it can find away from combat.

actions.name: Grasping Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) Piercing damage. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 10, target Medium or smaller creature successfully hit. Failure: Target creature has the Grappled condition (Escape DC 12). Until this Grapple ends, at the start of the daellash's turn while it is Grappling the creature, it automatically deals 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage as its jaws sink into the target.

actions.name: Gulping Maw
actions.desc: The daellash makes one Grasping Bite attack against a Medium or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target creature is swallowed, and the Grapple condition ends. The swallowed target is Blinded and Restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the daellash, and it takes 5 (2d4) Bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the daellash's turns. The daellash can only have one target swallowed at a time. If the daellash dies, a swallowed creature is no longer Restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 5 ft. of movement exiting Prone.

name: Daugon
flavor: Basking on the stony beaches of the Sol'Kesh coasts, the daugon is a survivor of two extreme temperature dualities. Found deep along the ocean floor, protected by a layer in thick blubber to withstand the frigid depths in which it scavenges for mollusks. By high noon, the large mammal will then rise to the surface, chewing through coastal plants while basking in the heat of the sun. When laying out on the beach, a dorsal sail arches upward, helping warm its blood to once again return to the depths. The striking colors of the sail's sunburst pattern is only found on males as they are used as a display towards potential mates. The matriarchal herd mothers often have their pick of competing males during the warm summer season and the bright colors make for a robust male to pick.

bio.niche: Generalist Semi-Aquatic Omnivore Preyed upon by Daellash, Goliarch, Slannethiss, Spiera, Vinnirex · Preys on Cariver, Trawlauth, Trikautrae

traits.name: Robust Nose
traits.desc: The daugon has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) Checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Depth Diver
traits.desc: The daugon can hold its breath for 2 hours.

traits.name: Solar Sail
traits.desc: As a Free Action, the daugon can raise its sail. Until the start of its next turn, it gains Resistance to Fire damage.

defensive_instinct: Defensive Instinct (1/Day) When a friendly daugon that it can see or smell dies within 60 ft. of it a fury overcomes the simple beast. On its turn, Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 12, the daugon. Success: The daugon hoots loudly as it becomes enraged. It can do a Hoot of the Herd Bonus Action as a Free Action, that adds 2d4 bonus instead of 1d4. Even if it has expended its daily use.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The daugon makes two attacks, using Pebbled Headbutt, Sharpened Incisors, and Tail Slam in any combination

actions.name: Pebbled Headbutt
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll : +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage. Strength Saving Throw: DC 13, one Medium or smaller creature the daugon has successful hit. Failure: The target has the Prone condition .

actions.name: Sharpened Incisors
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Tail Slam
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage.

name: Spiera
flavor: Like the scales of a great sea serpent, sunlight glimmers off the mantles of a spiera shoal that race beneath the waves. With the use of forward facing siphuncles and numerous expelling jets, spiera squid are an agile and overpowering shoal. Launching into schools of fish, grasping morsels of flesh in their fanged tentacles and continuing onward before the scent of blood attracts larger predators. When chancing upon enormous creatures like cetaceans and gigantic basking sharks, the shoal charges forward in a blinding stream of bubbles. With a sickening sequence of deeply heard thuds, dozens of squid slam their chitin-hardened mantle spears into the flesh of their prey, their long tentacles holding on tight as they feast on the quickly sinking creature before it falls too far into the black depths.

bio.niche: Specialist Pursuit Carnivore Preyed upon by Goliarch, Slannethiss · Preys on Daellash, Daugon, Rauka, Tiama

traits.name: Water Breathing
traits.desc: The spiera can breathe only underwater.

traits.name: Under Current
traits.desc: The spiera has Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made while underwater.

traits.name: Shoal Swarm
traits.desc: When the spiera makes an attack, any other friendly spiera within 5 ft. of it can use its Reaction to make an attack against the same target. The spiera executing Reaction attacks do not generate further Reaction attacks by other spiera in proximity to them.

traits.name: Wary Instinct
traits.desc: (1/Day) When startled, the shoal spreads a billowing black cloud in unison, obscuring great swaths of the ocean. Reaction Trigger: When a friendly spiera that it can see within 30 ft. of it releases its Ink Cloud. Response - Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 10, the spiera. Success: The spiera uses its Ink Cloud unless it had already used it that day.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The spiera makes two attacks, using Spearing Mantle, Hooked Tentacles and Scissor Beak in any combination.

actions.name: Spearing Mantle
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll : +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit : 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage. If the spiera swam 20+ ft. straight toward the target creature immediately before the hit , the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Hooked Tentacles
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Slashing damage. If the target is a Normal or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (Escape DC 14). Until this Grapple ends, the target is Restrained, and the spiera cannot use its tentacles on another target.

actions.name: Scissor Beak
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) Piercing damage. If the targeted creature is Restrained by the spiera's Hooked Tentacle attack, the spiera has Advantage on its Scissor Beak attack.

name: Trikautrae
flavor: As the sun sets, the armored urchin slowly crawls out of the water with its long repurposed spines, perching itself on rocky outcrops to open its clam-like lid to reveal the waving luminescent tendrils within. Motes of glowing bacteria flow within the transparent skin of the tendrils as they wave back and forth in the gloom of the dusk light like a nest of worms to catch the eye of the high flying sea birds. Once sighted, they quickly descend to pluck the little wriggling lures, just as their beak nearly closes in on the glowing lures, the lid snaps shut with shocking force. Th ese tendrils are coated in a paralyzing neurotoxin that numbs the flesh of their victim and stills their thrashing struggle, while the hard calcite teeth of the urchin slowly grinds the immobilized prey to a grizzly end. Covered in a skin of fluid, suffused with a neurotoxin, the tendrils that rim the edge of the urchin can temporarily numb the extremities of creatures on contact. Fringed by a ring of large, flattened modified spines, the urchin can pivot and rotate them for a measured pace of locomotion. While slow, the trikautrae can crawl up past the tide to entice nearby scavengers. Along the rocky shores of the Strands, the trikautrae is often found nestled among the stones and tidal pools. Never venturing far from the water, it often comes ashore at night, opening its wide mouth to entrap prey with its luminescent glowing tendrils that wave in the moonlit air. During the day, nestled among the clams and stones, it is much harder to spot.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: Th e trikautrae can breathe both air and water.

traits.name: Tidal Camouflage
traits.desc: While the trikautrae remains motionless with its shell closed, it is indistinguishable from the surrounding stones. It has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to Hide while in the Strands biome or coastal-like environments.

defensive_instinct: When near death, its shell closes against intrusion. Reaction Trigger: When the trikautrae is reduced to 0 hit points. Response - Constitution Saving Th row: DC 12, the trikautrae. Success: Th e Trikautrae's mouth remains tightly closed upon death, blocking the Scavenging of its Paralytic Tendril Knot and Concentrated Digestion Enzyme. Any effort to open its mouth requires a DC 17 Strength check.

actions.name: Paralyzing Clamp ( Open )
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Roll : +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit : 11 (2d6 + 3) Piercing damage. Constitution Saving Th row: DC 14, target creature the trikautrae has successfully hit. Failure: Th e target creature has the Paralyzed condition for 6 minutes. Th e Paralyzed target can repeat the Saving Th row at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Devour ( Open)
actions.desc: Strength Saving Th row: DC 14, one Medium or smaller creature Grappled by the trikautrae (it can one creature swallowed at a time). Failure: Th e target is swallowed. A swallowed creature has the Paralyzed and Restrained conditions, has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the trikautrae, and takes 4 (1d6) Acid damage at the start of each of the trikautrae's turns. If the trikautrae takes 20 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the trikautrae must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution Saving Th row at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls in a space within 5 ft. of the trikautrae and has the Prone condition. If the trikautrae dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse using 5 ft. of movement, exiting Prone.

actions.name: Shelled Tackle (Closed)
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage.

name: Tiama Shoal
flavor: Tiama skim over the waves in great flying shoals with their elongated mouths extended over the water as they weave in and out of the exposed coral structures of the Strands, snatching the many insects that flit about the undulating colorful fronds. At three to four feet long, these creatures fall prey to many predators of both land and sea, surviving only by the coordinated quick movements of their shoal and always alert, orb-like eyes that dart back and forth, looking for the slightest sign of danger. When threatened and escape is no longer an option, the shoal will turn on the aggressor like a storm of razor sharp fi ns, leaving any would-be-predator bleeding and sinking beneath the waves as the shoal flies past. Highly sensitive feelers aid the tiama in sensing air currents and atmospheric pressure to guide the shoal to warm air pockets where ocean-borne insects tend to swarm. Rarely ever seen alone, the tiama lives exclusively in large groups and act as one. Fishing for tiama can be diffi cult as they can seamlessly switch between swimming and gliding over the waves with ease. Once the swarm feels overly threatened, the shoal will flee in a manner requiring the most effort by the pursuer.
subtype: Large Swarm of Medium Beasts, Unaligned, Aggressive

traits.name: Swarming Shoal
traits.desc: Th e shoal can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the shoal can move through any opening large enough for a Medium creature. Th e shoal cannot regain Hit Points or gain temporary Hit Points.

traits.name: Aggressive Instinct
traits.desc: When the tiama shoal is engaged in combat and Bloodied, they begin to coordinate their efforts in a frenzy. On its turn, Dexterity Saving Th row: DC 13, the tiama shoal. Each creature within 5 ft. of the tiama shoal. Failure: 10 (3d6) Slashing damage. Success: Half damage.

traits.name: Slashing Flight
traits.desc: Th e shoal can fly through a target creature's space, dealing 7 (2d6) Slashing damage to the target creature when it enters its space for the fi rst time or when the creature starts its turn in the tiama shoal's space.

traits.name: Tidal Glide
traits.desc: If the shoal moves in a non-straight line or under 30 ft. during its movement, it loses its flying speed and can only move by swimming until the end of its turn.

actions.name: Razored Fins
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the shoal's space. Hit : 17 (4d6+3) Slashing damage, or 10 (2d6+3) Slashing damage if the shoal has half of its Hit Points or fewer.

reactions.name: Disperse
reactions.desc: When the tiama shoal takes damage from an attack, it can momentarily scatter into individual fi sh as a Reaction, reducing the damage taken by half. Th e shoal of tiama then immediately reassemble.

name: Vortautilus
flavor: Often heard more than seen along undersea cliffs, billowing clouds of grit obscure several vortautili that slam and grind into stone to dislodge barnacles and clams, grasping them in their black tentacles. With adaptations to survive the frigid depths and migrations to colder climes, the vortautilus' is suffused with an ethanol-like fluids that allows them to function in waters that most other aquatic life would suffer a slow torpor. Th ese cephalopod take advantage of the lack in competition during the colder seasons. When sheets of ice begin to form in the depths of winter, resonating deep cracking sounds are often heard as they spin violently into the ice sheets, creating new waterways to search for their favored prey, or, as the new year dawns, slamming in bouts of contending for mates. Dozens of dark inky tentacles coil outwards from the cephalopod's head. While lacking suction cups, they harbor a powerful grip, capable of constricting and breaking rock-hard barnacles and large crustaceans with ease. Found in hunting groups of several individuals, the vortautilus are often obscured in billowing clouds of sand and debris as they break and tear at the ocean floor looking for clams and urchins to feast on. Naturally curious, they will approach a Traveler if they offer a soft fleshed starfi sh for them to snatch into their many grasping tentacles, but will attack in unison if threatened.

traits.name: Water Breathing
traits.desc: Th e vortautilus can breathe only water, With the use of its chambered shell, it may hold its breath for 1 hour.

traits.name: Curling Shell
traits.desc: Th e vortautilus can retract or emerge from its shell as an Action. While retracted, it gains +2 bonus to AC (total 18) and cannot use the Gripping Tentacles or Spiral Vortex attacks but it may use its Th ermal Torrent and Jet Siphon.

traits.name: Digging Spiral
traits.desc: Th e vortautilus can burrow through solid earth and ice at a speed of 5 ft. leaving behind a 3 ft. wide tunnel.

traits.name: Spinning Shoal
traits.desc: When the vortautilus moves and performs a Spiral Vortex Attack towards a target creature, any allied vortautili that are within 30 ft. and can see the target creature may use their Bonus Action to move up to their speed towards the same target creature and make a Spiral Vortex Attack as well.

defensive_instinct: Aggressive Instinct (1/Day) When an allied vortautilus is slain within eyesight, instincts of protecting its kin takes over. On its turn, Wisdom Saving Th row: DC 16, the vortautilus. Success: Th e vortautilus' Th ermal Torrent Action is automatically recharged and it can roll a Th ermal Torrent attack towards the nearest enemy within range as a Bonus Action.

actions.name: Gripping Tentacles
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (Escape DC 12) from all dozen tentacles. While Grappled, the target has the Restrained Condition and the vortautilus cannot use their Gripping Tentacles until they release the target.

actions.name: Spiral Vortex
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) Slashing damage. If the vortautilus swam 20+ ft. straight toward the target creature immediately before the hit , the target takes an extra 4 (1d8) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Th ermal Torrent (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Th e vortautilus releases a jet of ethanol laced water in a 30 ft. line that is 1 ft. wide. Dexterity Saving Th row: DC 14, each creature in that line. Failure: 7 (2d6) Bludgeoning damage and pushes the creature 10 ft. away. Success: Half damage.

reactions.name: Jet Siphon
reactions.desc: Trigger: A creature the vortautilus can see hits it with an attack roll. Response -Dexterity Saving Th row: DC 13, the vortautilus. Success: Th e attack misses instead and the vortautilus propels itself 10 ft. directly backwards without provoking Opportunity attacks.

name: Arkiopti
flavor: Floating near the surface, six small eyes rise over the waves in search of feathered prey. With paddle-like limbs the large crustacean treads water with a slow measured pace to match the rhythm of the waves so as not to stir the water around the stalks of its peeking eyes . When a flock of sea birds approach, it will carefully raise its articulated maw from the water, retching out a mucus-covered stone shard, one of many that rest within its gullet. With all six eyes tracking the bird's flight, a lethally precise hit cuts through the feathered prey, dropping it down to splash on the surface. With its prize floundering on the tide, the crustacean then awkwardly swims over to the dying bird and grasps it in its clawed forelimbs before it sinks and is lost to the many scavengers below the waves. Six articulated paddle-shaped limbs allow the crustacean to tread water for hours at a time. Thick tendrils filled with excess nitrogen trails from each paddle and the arkiopti's wide tail, aiding the creature's buoyancy. Th ough diffi cult to track from a distance, once seen just under the waves the arkiopti is slow to evade threats. It instead relies on defending itself by fi ring off its store of regurgitated stones at aggressive predators. If assailed from other seaborne creatures, it will fi ght for its life with the use of its strong limbs and sharp clasping claws.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: Th e arkiopti can breathe both air and water.

traits.name: Multitude of Eyes
traits.desc: Th e arkiopti has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

traits.name: Sensitive Sight
traits.desc: When the arkiopti takes 10 or more Radiant damage. Constitution Saving Th row: DC equal to the damage taken to a maximum of 20, the arkiopti. Failure: Th e arkiopti has the Blinded condition for 1 minute.

defensive_instinct: Wary Instinct When reduced to a quarter (26) of its starting hit points, the large crustacean looks to escape. On its turn, Constitution Saving Th row: DC 12, the arkiopti. Failure: Th e arkiopti takes the Disengage action and flees. Sinking below the water's surface, if it reaches the seafloor it can then return with its Regurgitated Stone ability fully recharged.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Th e arkiopti makes three attacks, using Grasping Claw, Regurgitated Stone and Mucous Retch in any combination.

actions.name: Grasping Claw
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll : +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit : 12 (2d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage, if the target is a Medium or smaller creature it has the Grappled condition (Escape DC 14). Th e arkiopti has two claws, each can Grapple a separate target creature.

actions.name: Regurgitated Stone
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll : +7 to hit, range 60/120 ft., one target. Hit : 15 (2d10 + 4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Mucous Retch (Recharge 3-6)
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll : +7 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit : 13 (3d6 +3) Acid damage, and the target is Restrained (Escape DC 12) by a thick viscous mucus.

reactions.name: Covering Splash
reactions.desc: Trigger: A creature the arkiopti can see while it is swimming in water hits it with a Ranged attack roll. Response - Dexterity Saving Th row: DC 14, the arkiopti . Success: Th e arkiopti adds +3 to its AC (total 20) for the duration of the attack as it splashes violently, raising a wall of water around it.

name: Goliarch
flavor: A behemoth among its meager lineage, the goliarch prowls the deep using its feeder limbs to grasp and pull anything it can into its needle-toothed maw. Often found drifting along the surface listlessly, preserving energy, only until its abyssal black eyes spot a glimmer of life in those darkened depths does it explode into ferocious motion. Dozens of paddle-shaped limbs churn the water as it barges into coral and stone alike to latch its many bladed maxilliped into a prey's flesh to feast. When the rare occurrence of a whale fall happening near the shores of Sol'Kesh, they converge upon them in fi erce masses of savage hunger, often cannibalizing their own as much as feasting on the fallen cetacean in a mad frenzy.
senses: Darkvision 120 ft., Tremorsense 60 ft., passive Perception 12

name: Slannethiss
flavor: Evolved to stalk silently, little escapes this blind amphibian. A long, sensitive, dual-horned nose leads its way when in dark waters, sensing the electromagnetic pulse of nearby creatures. Their frightened heartbeats like a call to the slaughter as its long lithe body swims silently along the coral strands that twists over and under the waves. For those believing the shore is safe from its extrasensory abilities, dozens of heat pits line the creature's head, allowing a full spectrum of thermal vision to aid this large nocturnal amphibian to dominate wide stretches of the shoreline. When rains pummel the coast, muffling the sound of its approach, it ventures further inland for warm blooded prey. These super-sensory narrow organs are packed with receptor cells that detect movement and subtle electric fields produced by its prey. Paired with thermal pits along its muzzle, very little escapes this apex predator.

bio.niche: Amphibious Apex Carnivore Preys upon Arkiopti, Daugon, Illithisk, Goliarch, Nicalliath, Sacrissian, Vinnirex

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
traits.desc: If the slannethiss fails a Saving Throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The slannethiss can breathe both air and water.

traits.name: Sensory Horned
traits.desc: The slannethiss has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks, and while underwater its twin horns allow the slannethiss to know the exact location of any other creature underwater for 100 ft..

traits.name: Shoreline Stalker
traits.desc: The slannethiss has Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to Hide while in the Strands or equivalent environments. In addition, while in dim light or darkness, the slannethiss can take the Hide action as a Bonus action.

traits.name: Wickedly Fast
traits.desc: Opportunity attacks against the slannethiss are made with Disadvantage.

traits.name: Slippery
traits.desc: If the slannethiss succeeds on a Dexterity Saving Throw, it takes no damage from effects that would deal half damage on Success.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The slannethiss makes three attacks, using Crushing Tarsus, Heaving Bulk, Mandible Bite or Viscous Webbing in any combination.

actions.name: Aggressive Instinct (1/Day)
actions.desc: When an enemy creature within melee combat range of it is Bloodied, a thirsting hunger overtakes the beast. On its turn, Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 12, the slannethiss. Success: For the remainer of the combat encounter, the slannethiss' attack rolls have Advantage against the Bloodied creature.

actions.name: Grasping Talons
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (6d6 + 7) Slashing damage. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 16, Medium or smaller sized creature that the slannethiss has hit with its Grasping Talons attack. Failure: Target creature has the Grapple condition (escape DC 17). The slannethiss can grapple two creatures at a time.

actions.name: Twisting Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 32 (5d10 + 5) Piercing damage. Strength Saving Throw: DC 17, Medium or smaller sized creature that the slannethiss has hit with its Twisting Bite attack. Failure: 22 (4d10) Slashing damage as the slannethiss whips its head back and forth.

actions.name: Slapping Tail
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10+5) Piercing damage. Strength Saving Throw: DC 15, one Medium or smaller creature the slannethiss has successfully hit with its Slapping Tail. Failure: The target is pushed back 5 ft. and has the Prone condition.

reactions.name: Redirecting Charge
reactions.desc: Trigger: A creature the slannethiss can see hits it with a Lighting attack. Response - Constitution Saving Throw: DC 5 + damage taken from the Lighting attack, the slannethiss. Success: The slannethiss targets one creature within 30 ft. of it to take half the redirected as Lightning damage.

name: Daellash Elver
flavor: While the daellash adult is a solitary ambush predator, its young benefit from staying near their kin. Dozens expose their heads into the vacillating current of the waves near the shoreline from tiny little burrows they dig their long bodies. Waiting to snatch any stray fish with their trap-like jaws and, just as quickly, retreating into the sand when something larger nears.

traits.name: Saturated Gill Branches
traits.desc: The daellash elver can breathe only underwater, and can survive without oxygen for 30 minutes.

traits.name: Hunting Kin
traits.desc: The daellash elver has Advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the daellash elver 's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Snapping Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll : +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4+2) Piercing damage.

reactions.name: Slip Away
reactions.desc: Trigger: When an enemy the daellash elver can see makes an attack roll against it, before damage is dealt. Response - Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 12, the triggering creature. Failure: The attack misses instead as the elver slips into its hole momentarily.

name: Vortautilus Baby
flavor: Small and thin shelled compared to its adult form, the baby vortautilus swims low to the ocean floor, rushing into the safety of dug tunnels made from older kin. Typically feasting on the remains of their hunt, the babies will rarely, if ever, engage in any combat; instead will use their nascent ethanol streams to keep aggressive beasts at bay.

traits.name: Water Breathing
traits.desc: The vortautilus baby can breathe only water, With the use of its chambered shell, it may hold its breath for 1 hour.

traits.name: Shell Safety
traits.desc: The vortautilus baby can retract or emerge from its shell as an Action, gaining a +1 bonus to AC (total 14) when retracted.

actions.name: Thermal Stream
actions.desc: The vortautilus baby releases a jet of ethanol laced water in a 15 ft. line that is 1 ft. wide. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 12, each creature in that line. Failure: 1 Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Jettison (Bonus Action)
actions.desc: The vortautilus baby moves up to 30 ft. in a straight line, this movement doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it swims out of an enemy's reach.

name: Gharril Juvenile
flavor: A single large eye peers from a shell half-buried in the sand, waves of the tide break upon the small outcropping and patiently it waits for the telltale slap of a flopping stranding fish. Bubbles pop and spew eagerly from its maw as the little mollusk spies its land-trapped prey and, with a shimmy and tug, it pulls itself from the sand and rushes over to the glistening meal.

bio.biome: sand, Strands biome or coastal-like environments

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: A gharril juvenile can breathe both air and water.

traits.name: Coral Shelled
traits.desc: When a gharril juvenile's lower body is buried and remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a coral outcropping. It has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) Checks made to Hide while in the Strands biome or coastal-like environments.

actions.name: Shelled Tackle
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 Bludgeoning damage. If the gharril juvenile moved 20+ ft. straight toward the target immediately before the hit, the target takes an additional 1 Bludgeoning damage.

name: Illithisk Juvenile
flavor: Chittering amongst its young spawn, the energetic illithisk juveniles instinctively rub up against the larger adults, often pestering the larger crustaceans, and getting a sharp wack of their scythe-like arms to ward them off. While annoying, this behavior prompts the adult's symbiotic urchin to germinate and spread to the younger generation of crustaceans.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: An illithisk juvenile can breathe both air and water.

actions.name: Small Scythe
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll : +3 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. Hit : 1 Slashing damage.

reactions.name: Bacterial Burst
reactions.desc: Trigger: The illithisk juvenile is slain. Response - Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature in a 10 ft. Emanation originating from the illithisk juvenile. Failure: 7 (2d6) Poison damage. Success: Half damage.

name: Mawgraw
flavor: The carnivorous plant grows on vertical surfaces, its primary stalk able to shift slightly to allow its wide peristome to catch falling creatures within a 5 ft. Sphere. The mawgraw is not a plant attempting to hide and can be found along coastal cliffs, hoping to capture curious birds or falling terrestrial animals.
senses: Tremorsense 5 ft. (Blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 6

traits.name: Trap Space
traits.desc: The carnivorous plant grows on vertical surfaces, its primary stalk able to shift slightly to allow its wide peristome to catch falling creatures within a 5 ft. Sphere.

traits.name: Countering
traits.desc: The mawgraw is not a plant attempting to hide and can be found along coastal cliffs, hoping to capture curious birds or falling terrestrial animals.

reactions.name: Gulping Maw
reactions.desc: Trigger: When a Medium or smaller creature enters its Trap Space. Response -Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 14, the creature that triggered the Trap. Failure: The target is swallowed by the plant. A swallowed creature has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the plant, and takes 7 (2d6) Acid damage at the start of each of its turns. If the plant takes 2 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the creature breaks free and falls in a space within 5 ft. (in addition to any vertical space to the ground) of the plant and has the Prone condition. If the plant dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape from the plant using 5 ft. of movement, exiting Prone.

name: Lhoupin
flavor: Grass sways gently in the evening breeze and the mouse leaps from to shadow to shadow across the dimly lit prairie in search of its favored meal, the bulbwark. Th ese stone-hard nuts can lay untouched for days as only the lhoupin are able to break their thick shell. With a staccato of rapid squeaks, the mouse uses its unique loop ears as a resonating chamber to register the perfect pitch for assessing the density of the shell and, with expert accuracy, a nearly imperceptibly high frequency squeak shatters the nut. Although this trait has been developed for the procurement of food, when in danger the lhoupin is capable of doing the same against predators, squeaking in quick succession to fi gure out the exact pitch necessary to shatter carapace and bone alike.

bio.niche: Generalist Granivore Preyed upon by Hectatrex, Lanceleth, Scavick, Scorpithine, Thistlewing, Vinnirex

traits.name: Springing Legs
traits.desc: Th e lhoupin can jump up to 15 ft. horizontally and 10 ft. vertically, without the need of a running start.

traits.name: Looped Ears
traits.desc: Th e lhoupin can hear even the faintest of sounds over long distances, up to 300 ft.. It has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.

defensive_instinct: Wary Instinct: When the lhoupin is engaged in a combat encounter. As a Reaction, Wisdom Saving Th row: DC 11, the lhoupin. Success: Th e lhoupin Disengages away from combat. Th e lhoupin must repeat the Saving Th row on each of its turns, escaping further until it is passed.

actions.name: Nipping Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4+3) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Shatter Squeak (Recharge 4-6)
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Th row: DC 12, each creature in a 10 ft. Cone. Failure: 9 (2d8) Th under damage and has the Deafened condition for 1 minute. Success: Half damage.

reactions.name: Skitter Leap
reactions.desc: Trigger: A creature the lhoupin can see hits it with an attack roll. Response - Dexterity Saving Th row: DC 10, the lhoupin. Success: Th e attack misses and the lhoupin jumps to a free space with 10 ft. of it and doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it jumps out of an enemy's reach.

name: Scorpithine
flavor: Dragging its long abdomen behind it in the dew of the dawn grass, the arachnid searches for a fresh bloom of flowers to prepare for the rising sun. Once settled among the grass and stalks, it will raise its back to the sky. Expanding the segments of its pygidium into a semblance of the flowers that surround it, the scorpithine then quickly migrates pigment cells within to match the color of the surrounding petals and masterfully camouflages itself in the underbrush. Patiently it will wait with an eerie stillness in the warm morning sun until an unwary pollinator will chance upon its false blossom. Unlike the flowers around it, its petals are lined with gripping serrated edges, ready to close in on the prey. And once they do, the long clawed hind legs repeatably stab the struggling prey until it ceases to move and the arachnid is then ready to feast.

bio.niche: Specialist Ambusher Carnivore Preyed upon by Hectatrex, Scavick, Vinnierex · Preys on Axilot, Lhoupin

traits.name: False Flower
traits.desc: While the scorpithine remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from nearby flowers. A creature within 5 ft. of the scorpithine can make a DC 12 Wisdom (Perception) check to discern if the flower is real or false. If a Creature touches the scorpithine, it can make one Numbing Tarsus Attack against that Creature as a Reaction.

traits.name: Nimble
traits.desc: Th e scorpithine can climb diffi cult vertical surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Scampering Legs
traits.desc: Whenever the scorpithine successfully attacks a creature, it may Dash as a Bonus Action. Th is movement doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it moves out of an enemy's reach.

defensive_instinct: Wary Instinct (1/Day): Once the scorpithine is engaged in combat. On its turn, Wisdom Saving Th row: DC 12. the scorpithine. Failure: 1d6 of its Pygidium Petals fall to the floor and it Disengages away from combat. Th e scorpithine must repeat the Saving Th row on each of its turns, escaping further until it is passed.

actions.name: Nipping Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4+4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Numbing Tarsus
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4+4) Piercing damage. Constitution Saving Th row: DC 10, target creature that the scorpithine has successfully hit. Failure : 4 (1d8) Poison damage and has the Poisoned condition for one hour. Th e creature can repeat the Saving Th row at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself with a successful save. If a creature poisoned in this way fails 3 consecutive Constitution Saving Th rows against this effect they become Paralyzed until the Poison condition ends.

name: Stonecrest Sparrow
flavor: Among the rising peaks of the Sol'Kesh highlands, a single chirp pierces the calm morning air. For the blister grubs tunneling beneath the stone cliffs, this chirp is a deafening explosion of sound, shattering the cliff face in minute craters and exposing the crushed grubs for the little sparrow to snatch. Th ough small and skittish, these solitary birds have adapted their far reaching ability to communicate with each other over vast distances to a devastating effect when close. With a highly specialized resonating chamber within their crested beak, they can chirp tight bands of sound that can shatter stone and ironwood when next to the surface. While this can strain the delicate bones within its skull, the birds will not hesitate to use it when threatened by predators.

bio.niche: Specialist Insectivore Preyed upon by Lexati, Maedrynn, Skyelarx · Preys on Blister Grubs, Drafian [Young]

traits.name: Keen Eyes
traits.desc: Th e stonecrest sparrow has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

traits.name: Flutter Flight
traits.desc: Th e stonecrest sparrow doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

defensive_instinct: Defensive Instinct (1/Day) If it survives any attempt at being attacked. On its turn, Wisdom Saving Th row: DC 11, the stonecrest sparrow. Success: Th e stonecrest sparrow Shattering Chirp Attack is automatically recharged and it makes that attack as a Bonus Action if there is an enemy creature within range.

actions.name: Peck
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit : 4 (1d4 +2) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Shattering Chirp (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Th row: DC 12, each creature in a 15 ft. Cone. Failure: 9 (1d10 + 4) Th under damage and the target creature has the deafened Condition for 1 minute. Success: Half damage.

reactions.name: Nimble Wings
reactions.desc: Trigger: A creature the stonecrest sparrow can see hits it with an attack roll. Response - Dexterity Saving Th row: DC 13, the triggering creature. Failure: Th e attack misses instead.

name: Axilot
flavor: Th e quick pitter-patter of taloned feet speed over dry plains as the axilot rushes past circling scavengers. A dozen of their kind following suit, all directed at the large freshly slain carcass being torn apart by a famished predator under the arid day sun. With the sound of a sharp crack, it plunges into the fallen beast, its axe-like beak cracking through the ribcage and exposing the nutrient-rich organs for a fast snatch and hasty retreat. Its kin plunging in quick succession while the frustrated predator lashes out at the pestering flightless birds. With their precious prize held fi rmly in razored beaks, bright scarlet drops trail behind them as they escape the hunting ground. Wolfi ng down the meat while on the run, they take no rest as the flock continues their search to steal another meal.

bio.niche: Specialist Scavenger Omnivore Preyed upon by Argustaur, Draffer, Grahknash, Khanith, Maedrynn · Preys on Bloomux, Lhoupin, Tartakka

traits.name: Farplains Senses
traits.desc: Th e axilot has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or smell.

traits.name: Pack Strikes
traits.desc: Th e axilot has Advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the axilot 's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

defensive_instinct: Aggressive Instinct (1/Day): An allied axilot within 6o ft. that it can see is slain. As a Reaction, Wisdom Saving Th row: DC 10, the axilot. Success: It makes an Talons Attack Action against any enemy creature within 5 ft. as a Bonus Action if within range. Failure: It takes a Disengage action and attempts to move as far as possible from any hostile creatures.

actions.name: Axe Beak
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll : +4 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. Hit : 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing damage. If the axilot moves 20+ ft. immediately before the hit toward a creature, that target takes an extra 4 (1d8) Piercing damage. Constitution Saving Th row: DC 11, target creature that the axilot has successfully hit. Failure: Target creature has Disadvantage on their next attack roll.

actions.name: Talons
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll : +4 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. Hit : 7 (2d4 + 2) Slashing damage.

reactions.name: Flock Coordination
reactions.desc: Trigger: An allied axilot within 10 ft. of it that it can see makes a Dash action. Response Th e axilot can make a Dash action or Disengage action and move in the same direction if possible.

name: Bloomux
flavor: Among the lush flower-fi elds of Valedayn, slow plodding bloomux graze in great herds. Sipping nectar from the leagues of flowering fi elds with their long prehensile proboscises, these peaceful arthropods, standing at nearly seven feet tall, want nothing more than to grow their honeywombs for their gestating pupae during the summer. When predators approach the herd, the nectarivores will turn their spiny backsides outwards to dissuade any foolish hunter that attempts to get near. Th ough this presents their precious honeywombs to the attacker, the potential explosion of chitinous spikes, sticky nectar and wriggling pupae often proves fatal to predators, and allows the larvae to be eaten by scavengers for the next stage in their development.

bio.niche: Specialized Nectarivore Preyed upon by Axilot, Draffer, Grahknash, Khanith, Maedrynn, Tyrandroth

traits.name: Sweetest Scent
traits.desc: Th e bloomux have Advantage on any attack rolls against non-bloomux creatures covered in nectar.

traits.name: Prickly Hide
traits.desc: At the start of it its turn, the bloomux deals 3 (1d6) Piercing damage to any creature Grappling it.

traits.name: Fatal Burst
traits.desc: When the bloomux dies, it explodes in a burst of nectar and spines. DC 11 Dexterity Saving Th row , each creature in a 15 ft. radius Sphere centered on the bloomux. Failure: 10 (3D6) Piercing damage and is covered in a sticky honey, Reducing their movement speed by half. Success: Half damage. A nectar-covered creature can use an Action to wipe off the nectar.

defensive_instinct: Wary Instinct (Once): If the bloomux suffers a total of 10 or more damage in a single round of combat. As a Reaction, Constitution Saving Th row: DC 16, the bloomux. Failure: Th e bloomux immediately uses its Fatal Burst ability.

actions.name: Prickly Spines
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll : +5 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. Hit : 12 (3d6 + 3) Piercing damage.

name: Drafian
flavor: After eons of pressure to hasten the vulnerable metamorphosis that transforms a caterpillar into a butterfly, one species developed wing-like membranes during its larval form and simply continued feasting. Th is form of neoteny forced the creature to forgo the usual brief life span of sexual maturity and, instead the insect now grows large and lives past their year-long lifespan, hibernating in leafy nests and reaching egg laying adulthood once growing to a foot in length. While not capable of true flight like a butterfly, the drafi an, in its near larval state can nonetheless glide across great distances to fi nd rich feeding grounds. Such a gentle flight would be an easy meal for most predators had the drafi an's bodily fluids not be suffused with a neurotoxin from feasting on the toxic leaves of a drafwood tree.

bio.niche: Arboreal Specialist Herbivore Preyed upon by Maedrynn, Skyelarx, Tyrandroth, Ynnil

name: Hectatrex
flavor: A curiously feather-fringed avian head peers over tall grasses that rise from the plains like waves in an ocean. Th ese lone hunters use their height to survey the wide expanse of their domain for spotting prey scampering in the dry stalks, the prowl of larger, more fearsome predators, and the brightly colored fruit that grows on the lofty wollopon trees. With a long stride on wide clawed feet, the hectatrex bounds over the flat landscape evading predators and chasing down prey with ease, only being caught unaware in the waning hours of the setting sun as their sight is not well suited to low light conditions. Th ough often found alone, during the spring season a male and female bird will alternate protecting their young, vulnerable chicks that they conceal in grass woven warrens.

traits.name: Towering Sight
traits.desc: Th e hectatrex has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

traits.name: Bounding Stride
traits.desc: With a 10 ft. running start, the hectatrex can Long jump up to 25 ft.

traits.name: Aggressive Instinct (3/day)
traits.desc: If the hectatrex suffers damage by an enemy creature within 5 ft. of it, and hasn't used its Reaction this turn. Reaction Trigger: A creature the hectatrex can see hits it with an attack roll. Response - Dexterity Saving Th row: DC 14, the hecatrex. Success: Th e hectatrex kicks out and attacks. Melee Attack Roll : +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is pushed back 5 ft. to an unoccupied space.

traits.name: Skittering Agility
traits.desc: Trigger: A creature the hectatrex can see hits it with an attack roll. Response - Dexterity Saving Th row: DC 12, the triggering creature. Failure: Th e attack misses instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The hectatrex makes two attacks, using Serrated Beak and Hooked Talons in any combination.

actions.name: Serrated Beak
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll : +6 to hit, reach 10 ft.,one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Hooked Talon
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll : +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 4) Slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (Escape DC12).

name: Khanith
flavor: When the moon rises to its apex, lithe arthropods scamper across the Farplains, their powerful articulated legs propelling them quickly in search of sleeping prey. Th ese instinctual pack animals prowl silently, coordinating their movements through the use of pheromones. Searching for burrows, lone herd beasts or wayward young, once they chance upon an easy kill they encircle the prey quickly and strike with flight-assisted leaps; their forward tarsus claws and sharp mandibles plunging deep into flesh and chitin alike. Khanith share a curious relationship with the lumbering khanaur, their shared ancestry leaving echoes of a pheromone based understanding. Th is connection goes beyond a lack of predation, as the khanith have been seen fi ercely defending packs of khanaur from aggressors.

traits.name: Scents on the Wind
traits.desc: Th e khanith has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Predatory Tactics
traits.desc: Th e khanith has Advantage on an attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the khanith's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Aggressive Instinct (1/Day)
traits.desc: When an enemy creature within 60 ft. of it that the khanith can see is Bloodied. On its turn, Wisdom Saving Th row: DC 12, the khanith. Success: Th e khanith's Multiattack changes to: Th e khanith makes three attacks, using its Piercing Mandibles and Tarsus Claws in any combination. Th is lasts for the duration of the combat encounter.

traits.name: Distant Kin
traits.desc: If a friendly khanith or khanaur creature is attacked within 60 ft., surrounding khanith become aware by the use of pheromones. Khanaur are considered allies to the khanith.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Th e khanith makes two attacks, using its Piercing Mandibles and Tarsus Claws in any combination.

actions.name: Piercing Mandibles
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll : +6 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. Hit : 8 (1d8 + 4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Tarsus Claws
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll : +6 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. Hit : 5 (1d6 + 4) Slashing damage. If the khanith jumped 10+ ft. toward the target immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 3 (1d6) Slashing damage. Strength Saving Th row: DC 12, one Medium or smaller creature the khanith has successfully hit with its Tarsus Claws. Failure: Target has the Prone condition.

name: Korruk
flavor: Th ough covered in armored plates and wielding sword-like claws, the korruk looks almost apologetic in the way it carries itself. Th is mammal digs deep into the dry soil of the Grayfynn plains during the heat of the day digging for deep rooted plants and, at night, moves slowly above ground for fresher fare. Evidence of its passing is clear for most predators, a long dragging tail that often leads to a massive hole in the earth. When found underground, the rather docile looking mammal can turn surprisingly aggressive. When cornered, the korruk raises its dermal plates in a threatening display and will ferociously slash with its stone breaking claws, capable of cutting through flesh with devastating ease.

traits.name: Resistance
traits.desc: Slashing, Lightning

traits.name: Immunities
traits.desc: Blinded

traits.name: Soil Senses
traits.desc: Th e korruk has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell and Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

traits.name: Hollowing Earth
traits.desc: Th e korruk can burrow through solid rock at half its burrow speed, leaving a 10 ft. diameter tunnel in its wake.

traits.name: Aggressive Instinct (1/Day)
traits.desc: When a friendly korruk it can smell or hear within 60 ft. of it is slain. On its turn, Wisdom Saving Th row: DC 15, the korruk. Success: Th korruk gains Advantage on its Spade Claws attack action until the end of combat as it rages over the loss of its kin.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Th e korruk makes two attacks, using Spade Claws, Digging Bite and Collapse in any combination.

actions.name: Spade Claws
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll : +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8+6) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Digging Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll : +6 to hit, ignoring 1 point of the Target's AC due to the korruk's stone-breaking bite, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6+6) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Collapse (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: If a korruk is underground, it can destabilize the earth. Dexterity Saving Th row: DC 15, each creature in a 25 ft. radius Emanation centered on the korruk. Failure: 10 (3D6) Bludgeoning damage and has the Prone condition. Success: Half damage. Th e area becomes Diffi cult Terrain until cleared.

name: Tartakka
flavor: Galloping across dusty sparse grasslands, the fi ercely territorial tartakka roams in fast moving herds searching for shallow root vegetables to dig up with their stout claws. Capable of surviving long months of drought, they are covered in a leathery hide and can retain moisture with a thick deposit of fat that runs below their tail. Th ough smaller than the females, the males carelessly ram their knobby skulls and reinforced upper humps into each other on a regular basis in a constant reshuffling of herd hierarchy. Th is nearly manic behavior works in their favor when they are threatened by predators, both males and females charge forward in a sequence of devastating strikes, with long bounding leaps that end in a concussive barrage of meat and bone.

traits.name: Resistance
traits.desc: Slashing

traits.name: Vigilant
traits.desc: Th e tartakka has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.

traits.name: Aggressive Instinct (1/Day)
traits.desc: When a friendly tartakka it can see within 30 ft. of it is slain. On its turn, Wisdom Saving Th row: DC 14, the tartakka. Success: Th e tartakka gains the ability: Multiattack Th e tartakka makes two attacks, using Th ick Toothed Bite and Ramming Crest in any combination, for the duration of the encounter.

actions.name: Th ick Toothed Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit : 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Ramming Crest
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit : 8 (1d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature and the tartakka moved 20+ ft. straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) Bludgeoning damage and has the Prone condition.

name: Rutort
flavor: As a rather slow and docile creature, approaching the rutort is quite easy with calm and careful movement. Like many herd animals with poor sight, any loud noises or displays of aggression will startle them into action. The adult females, larger in comparison to their male counterparts, will lead the stampede in a furious goring rampage. A male and female roogi nest on the rather stable rutort, adapted to lifting their single egg in their talons in the rare event of a stampede. While the tusks churn the earth for tubers and vegetable matter, the long mandibles will drag the freshly turned vegetation into its vertical mouth to slowly chew through the hard fibrous meal.

traits.name: Grazers Senses
traits.desc: The rutort has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell, but Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks for sight.

traits.name: Indomitable
traits.desc: If damage reduces the rutort to 0 Hit Points. Constitution Saving Throw DC 5 + damage taken from the most recent hit, unless its from a Critical Hit. Success: The rutort drops to 1 hit point instead.

defensive_instinct: When a friendly rutort it can smell within 30 ft. of it is slain. On its turn, Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14 , the rutort. Success: The rutort gains +1 bonus to its Armor Class (total AC 18) and Resistance to Piercing for the duration of the combat encounter.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The rutort makes two attacks, using its Goring Tusk and Chitin Horn in any combination.

actions.name: Goring Tusks
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Chitin Horn
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. If target is a Large or smaller creature and the rutort moved 20+ ft. straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 3 (1d6) Piercing damage and has the Prone condition.

name: Draffer
flavor: With whooping howls, a dozen draffers break through the sparse cover on the Farplains in pursuit of prey. With cunning primal tactics, they run alongside herds of grazing beasts, forcing them into a long line as they nip and slash at their flanks. Over long miles they wear them down, the frail or young soon fall behind and the pursuing predators close in for the kill. With powerful legs they leap and slash with lateral bladed tusks, cutting deep wounds and bleeding their prey dry. As each herd beast collapses, draffer cubs pounce on the weakened animals in a frenzy as they furiously fight their litter kin for the choice meats, while the adults continue the pursuit onward, leaving a trail of carcasses in their wake for the pack to feast on. Despite its fearsome appearance the draffer lives in a tight familial pack, roaming across the colder Tundrus highlands caring for their young whilst on the move. Though a voracious pursuit predator, they will favor somewhat fresh carrion when the opportunity arises. Travelers who offer such grim gifts could pique their interest, often dispelling the initial aggressive demeanor they would display to other creatures. Sparse fur and a light-toned hide gives the predator a measure of camouflage on the northern plains. Lateral tusks eviscerate fleeing prey as the pack runs down herds in well practiced and lethal pincer formations.

traits.name: Running Leap
traits.desc: With a 10 ft. running start, a draffer can leap up to 30 ft. long and 5 ft. high.

traits.name: Pack Hunter
traits.desc: The draffer has Advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the draffer's allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

traits.name: Aggressive Instinct
traits.desc: (1/Day) When an enemy creature within 60 ft. of it that the draffer can see is Bloodied. On its turn, Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 10, the draffer. Success: The draffer's excitement for the hunt rises to new heights. It gains Advantage on Dexterity rolls, for the duration of the encounter.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The draffer makes two attacks, using Gnarl Toothed Bite or Rending Tusks in any combination.

actions.name: Gnarl Toothed Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll : +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit : 14 (3d8+2) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Rending Tusks
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll : +5 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6+3) Slashing damage. If the draffer moved 20+ ft. straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 6 (2d6) Slashing damage. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature the draffer has successful hit with its Rending Tusk attack. Failure: 3 ( 1d6) Slashing damage at the start of each of its turns due to a bleeding wound. The bleeding lasts for 1 minute or until the target receives healing or succeeds on a DC 12 Wisdom (Medicine) check to staunch the bleeding as an Action.

name: Khanaur
flavor: A deep grinding sound heralds the peaceful packs of khanaur as they chew through stalks of tall grass and dig up tubers to feed their voracious appetites. Roaming in groups of several individuals, their larvae stuck on the undersides of the adult members to keep their familial packs tight and moving, the khanaur travel the Farplains in slow seasonal migrations. Grazing in close proximity to each other to ward off any nearby predators, while the larger females of their group patrol, their massive forelimbs stomping into the soil to warn any that think they can attempt to penetrate their heavily armored chitin shells. Keeping pace with their roaming herd are packs of khanith, picking off smaller predators that would otherwise prey on the larvae grubs, their presence welcomed by their larger cousins. These large herbivores look deceptively docile when slowly grazing in the fields, their eyes staring vacantly as they chew, but they are always watching for danger. Once confronted by aggressive creatures they quickly form a defensive posture, their instinctual need to protect taking over. If roused to violence, there is little that would calm them until the hostile is long gone or crushed into the soil. With prodigious strength, the large insect uses its powerful hoof-shaped tarsal claws to tear into the soil and pull deep roots to feast on.

traits.name: Pack Protector
traits.desc: By the use of its enormously armored arms, when an ally of a khanaur is within 5 ft. and is the target of an attack, it can use its Reaction to force Disadvantage on the attacking creatures attack roll.

traits.name: Distant Kin
traits.desc: If a friendly khanaur or khanith creature is attacked within 60 ft., surrounding khanaur become aware by the use of pheromones. Khanith are considered allies to the khanaur.

traits.name: Forlorn Grief
traits.desc: Whenever the khanaur starts its turn with 20 hit points or fewer, and is the last of its allies within 60 ft., the khanaur enrages. The khanaur has Advantage on attack rolls, and is unable to Disengage from combat once engaged. Once the khanaur is enraged, it continues to do so until it is slain.

defensive_instinct: When an allied creature within 60 ft. of it that the khanaur can see is slain. On its turn the khanaur slams the ground in fury. Strength Saving Throw: DC 14, any creature within an 10 ft. Emanation centered on the khanaur. Failure: Target creature has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The khanaur makes two attacks, using its Crushing Fore Claws and Mandible Bite in any combination.

actions.name: Crushing Fore Claws
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll : +7 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. Hit : 10 (1d10 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, and the khanaur moved 20+ ft. straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Mandible Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack : +7 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. Hit : 14 (2d8 + 5) Piercing damage.

name: Argustaur
flavor: Despite its heavy gait, the argustaur is capable of relentlessly charging down a herd of rutort and running them into the ground with its persistent, near inexhaustible stamina. The ground shakes under its weight as its hoof-like feet pound the earth. Through the evolutionary need to move quickly and yet retain a measure of armored protection, this lizard has developed segmented plating while its legs have lengthened and straightened to gallop over the dry and arid soil. When closing in on prey, it will extend its neck to twice its length in a whip-fast snapping bite, sinking its teeth into its exhausted prey. Once sated, the lizard will spend days digesting and building back up its energy reserves, half buried in the soil and looking nothing less than a mound of stone and dirt. To conserve energy, this large reptile spends most of its time buried in the soil, waiting for prey. Only its yellowed teeth and red eyes visible in the mound of earth. Once any creature smaller than itself approaches, it will charge out in an explosion of soil and stone, attempting to clamp down with its toothed maw before the creature can evade the argustaur's short but frightening burst of speed. Beady eyes rest deep within an overhanging brow to protect its vision against the abrasive grit of its natural environment. When extended, the lizard's neck can reach a full four feet of length to lash out at unsuspecting prey or close the distance when in pursuit. The jaw, with its heavy under bite and overly developed mandibular teeth is built for quick snapping bites, the bite force exceeding many crocodilian genus equivalents. Hardened scales evolved into fused osteoderm plates to protect the lizard from most predation that can be found on the dry arid wastes while the toes have fused into hooves to run over the hard arid landscape. Nodules hang down from the creatures tail, used in sensing vibrations when the reptile rests beneath the stones and soil during the heat of the day in wait for prey.

traits.name: Ambush Predator
traits.desc: If the argustaur is motionless at the start of combat, and within the Farplains or equivalent environment, it has Advantage on its Initiative roll. If a creature hasn't noticed the argustaur move or act, that creature must succeed on an DC 16 Intelligence (Nature) or Wisdom (Perception) check to discern the argustaur from the surrounding terrain.

traits.name: Scenting the Wind
traits.desc: The argustaur has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Solid Footing
traits.desc: When pushing or pulling, the argustaur is considered to be one size larger, and if moved by physical means, it moves only half the distance, rounding up.

defensive_instinct: When Bloodied and in melee combat. On its turn, Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14 , the argustaur. Success: The argustaur settles into a defensive posture until the start of its next turn and all melee attack rolls that target it are made with Disadvantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The argustaur makes one Under Bite attack and one Hulking Stomp attack in any combination.

actions.name: Under Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) Piercing damage. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 13 , one Medium or smaller creature that the argustaur successfully hit with its Under Bite Attack. Failure: The target has the Grappled condition (Escape DC 13). While Grappling, the argustaur cannot use Under Bite on a different target.

actions.name: Hulking Stomp
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the argustaur moved 20+ ft. straight toward the target immediately before the hit, the target has the Prone condition.

name: Grahknash
flavor: Prowling over the dusty rock-strewn wastes of the Grayfynn, a grahknash surveys the horizon for prey. Savagely ravenous, the creature relentlessly follows herd beasts for miles along migration trails, its sand-blasted plates camouflaging it as it slowly approaches before exploding into action, charging down the weak and young. Little deters this lizard in its natural habitat as its thick sharp plates, that cover it from snout to spiked tail, defend it from all but the most ferocious of apex predators. When not actively hunting, the grahknash can curiously be found licking stone and mud, slowly building up silica deposits in its body to harden and strengthen its plating. This allows its scales and hard, knobby, club-like tail to not only be a suitable bludgeon but sharpened to a razored edge. These lone hunters have wide hunting ranges and only in the rare breeding months could two be found together, often defending their clutch of eggs from rival mating pairs. When not actively prowling or sleeping through the heat of the day, the grahknash can be found licking stones in order to build up the silica deposits in its body to harden and strengthen its plated scales. Plating splits along a horizontal seam across its face, exposing eyes and nostrils. This break in the armor can close during particularly fierce dust storms, leaving the grahknash safe from the abrasive sands.

traits.name: Wasteland Senses
traits.desc: The grahknash has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell and has Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

traits.name: Sandstone Scales
traits.desc: If a creature attacks the grahknash with a melee attack roll and misses it by 10 or less, the attacker suffers 7 (2d6) Slashing damage as they are cut by the creature's scales.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The grahknash can either makes two attacks with Fanged Maw, Shard Talons and Blade Tipped Tail in any combination.

actions.name: Fanged Maw
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Shard Talons
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing damage. If the grahknash moved at least 20+ ft. toward the target immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Blade Tipped Tail
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Slashing damage. Strength Saving Throw: DC 16, target Medium or smaller creature that the grahknash has successfully hit. Failure: Target creature is pushed back 10 ft..

reactions.name: Aggressive Instinct (Reaction)
reactions.desc: When the grahkbnash has reached 0 hit points. Reaction Trigger: A creature the grahknash can see hits it with an attack roll. Response - Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, the grahknash. Success: It lashes out in a final spasm of rage, and can make a Move and a single melee attack roll of its choice towards the nearest enemy. Afterwards, the grahknash collapses, slain.

name: Tyrandroth
flavor: A high pitch droning heralds death for many mega-fauna that roam the Farplains, stampeding in terror from a tyrandroth on the hunt. The large dragonfly, a fortunately rare sight, as the predatory insects compete viciously with themselves for territory or mating couplings that end with the male being eviscerated by the larger females. This fierce aerial hunter will often run down herds, singling out stragglers with its exothermic caustic chemical spray to blind and cripple them before descending and ripping apart flesh to feast.
