While this insect cannot hope to fly and survive when the murmurations of the maedrynn are at their height of savagery, the tyrandroth absolutely dominates the Farplains as a reigning apex predator for most of the year, only fearing another of its lethal kind.

traits.name: Compound Vision
traits.desc: The tyrandroth is capable of seeing in nearly 360 degrees around itself and has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

traits.name: Agile Flier
traits.desc: When the tyrandroth makes a melee attack, it can immediately use its remaining movement speed to fly away. This doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Single Minded
traits.desc: The tyrandroth has Advantage on Saving Throws against the Charmed or Frightened Conditions.

traits.name: Droning Flight
traits.desc: When flying, the tyrandroth's wings emit a loud droning sound that can be heard to a range of 200 ft., and while flying the tyrandroth has Disadvantage on Stealth checks.

traits.name: Aggressive Instinct
traits.desc: (1/Day) When the tyrandroth is in combat and Bloodied. On its turn, Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 12, the tyrandroth Success: The tyrandroth enters a state of heightened aggression and has Advantage on its Tetrad Mandibles attack until the end of the combat encounter.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The tyrandroth makes two attacks with its Tetrad Mandibles, Hooked Tarsus and Caustic Spray in any combination.

actions.name: Tetrad Mandibles
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Hooked Tarsus
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 5) Slashing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, and the tyrandroth moved +30ft. toward it immediately before the hit, the target has the Grappled and Restrained condition (Escape DC 16). The tyrnadroth can move while grappling a creature but cannot use its Hooked Tarsus attack again until it releases the grappled creature.

actions.name: Caustic Spray
actions.desc: (Recharge 5-6) Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 30 ft. Cone. Failure: 17 (5d6) Acid damage and 14 (4d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.

name: Maedrynn Murmuration
flavor: Thousands of maedrynn hummingbirds gather into a great murmur during their ferocious mating season, darkening the sky and becoming an absolute apex predator. They descend like a tornado of serrated beaks, ripping and flensing flesh from bone to fuel their rapid metabolism and to line their nests with meat for their hatchlings. This destructive force, though beautiful to behold, is a natural calamity that sweeps the Farplains.
subtype: Gargantuan Swarm of Tiny Beasts, Unaligned, Wary

traits.name: Thousands of Eyes
traits.desc: The swarm has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

traits.name: Cloud of Birds
traits.desc: The swarm occupies a 30 ft. radius (Gargantuan) space and can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny creature.

traits.name: Undulating Murmuration
traits.desc: The swarm of birds moves in dizzying patterns. Ranged attack rolls outside of 60 ft. are made with Disadvantage against it.

traits.name: Trilling Death
traits.desc: Creatures have the Deafened condition while within the swarm's space. In addition, any creature within 60 ft. must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution Saving Throw on each of their turns to maintain their Concentration.

traits.name: Frenzied
traits.desc: The swarm has Advantage on attack rolls against Bloodied creatures.

traits.name: Aggressive Instinct (1/Day)
traits.desc: When Bloodied and in melee combat. On its turn, Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 18, the swarm. Success: Individual maedrynn flock to join the swarm, the maedrynn murmuration swarm immediately gains 10 (1d20) Health Points (HP).

traits.name: Resistances
traits.desc: Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing

traits.name: Vulnerabilities
traits.desc: Thunder

traits.name: Immunities
traits.desc: Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Prone, Restrained, Stunned

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The swarm makes three attacks, using Serrated Beaks, Hungering Outliers, or Feasting Storm in in any combination.

actions.name: Serrated Beaks
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +15 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. Hit: 36 (8d6+8) Slashing damage, or 22 (4d6+8) Slashing damage if the swarm is Bloodied. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 8, one creature that the swarm successfully hit with its Serrated Beaks attack. Failure: The target has the Blind condition until the swarms next turn, as the birds slash at their eyes.

actions.name: Hungering Outliers
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +15 to hit, reach 60 ft., one target. Hit: 29 (6d6+8) Slashing damage, or 18 (3d6+8) Slashing damage if the swarm is Bloodied.

actions.name: Feasting Storm
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 18, all creatures within the swarm's space. Failure: 38 (12d4+8) Slashing damage and the creature has the Prone condition, or 23 (6d4+8) Slashing damage if the swarm is Bloodied. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Legendary Action Uses
actions.desc: 3 (4 in Lair). Immediately after another creature's turn, the maedrynn murmuration can expend a Legendary Action Use to take one of the following actions. The swarm regains all expended Legendary Actions at the start of each of its turns.

actions.name: Disperse
actions.desc: The swarm spreads out in a tall column, leaving more space between each individual bird. The swarm gains +1 bonus to its Armor Class (total AC 22) and loses its Vulnerability to Thunder damage, until the beginning of its turn.

actions.name: Screeching Cacophony
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14, all creatures within the swarm's space. Failure: 16 (3d10) Thunder damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Pulling Beaks
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 16, one target in the swarm's space. Failure: Target has the Restrained condition (Escape DC 14) as birds pluck and pull at their limbs.

name: Lone Adult Maedrynn
flavor: Far from removed from the terrifying murmur that slaughters anything under its shadow, a single maedrynn looks to be nothing more than a regular hummingbird. Only when threatened do they make their particular shrieking call, summoning others to flock in aid, their aggressive ripping bites begin to be reminiscent of their lethal mating season.

traits.name: Agile Flier
traits.desc: The maedrynn doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Moribeak Shriek
actions.desc: The maedrynn can call for aid. Any nearby maedrynn within 100 ft. may answer and join the maedrynn by its next turn.

actions.name: Ripping Beak
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll : +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit : 1 Slashing damage.

reactions.name: Flutter Flight
reactions.desc: Trigger: A creature the maedrynn can see hits it with an attack roll. Response - Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 14, the triggering creature. Failure: The attack misses instead.

name: Tyrandroth Nymph
flavor: Swimming in shallow ponds and lakes that dot the great expanse of the Farplains, the aggressive nymphs outweigh any of their kind, capable of snatching fully grown fish in their grasping mandibles. Rapacious in the extreme, the nymph hunts and feasts the moment it hatches, rushing to not only escape the water and take flight, but to do so before hundreds of its kin do the same.

traits.name: Aquatic Infancy
traits.desc: The tyrandroth nymph can breathe only underwater.

traits.name: Lethal Water's Edge
traits.desc: When submerged in water, the tyrandroth nymph has Advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has Surprised.

name: Draffer Cub
flavor: Born to race alongside its pack, the draffer cub rushes as quickly as its small legs can carry it to keep up with them on the hunt. While its tusks are little more than sharpened nubs, the cub learns from watching the pack how to encircle and harass the herds, to slash and cut to bleed them dry. Feasting on the scavenged remains, the adults often leave the rich organ meat for their young to grow strong on.

traits.name: Enthusiastic Leap
traits.desc: With a 10 ft. running start, a draffer cub can leap up to 10 ft. long and 5 ft. high.

traits.name: Bounding Energy
traits.desc: If the draffer cub succeeds on a Dexterity Saving Throw, it takes no damage from effects that would deal half damage on Success.

actions.name: Tiny Tusks
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll : +4 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) Slashing damage.

name: Tartakka Calf
flavor: Purposefully breeding only the most quarrelsome individuals to protect their quick moving herd, it is no wonder that the tartakka calves are found to be incredibly excited and playful. Often bounding ahead of the herd, only reigning back into the protective circle of the adults when their curiosity disturbs something large and frightful.

traits.name: Playful
traits.desc: The tartakka calf has Disadvantage on Perception (Wisdom) checks, as it's too busy rushing around joyfully.

actions.name: Short Toothed Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit : 1 Piercing damage.

name: Ruske
flavor: A warm breeze sways drooping willow branches, stirring a slow gentle river, its wide banks home to long strands of cattails. Thick clusters of lily pads with slow moving, wedge-shaped-shelled creatures quietly chewing, quietly chewing through them at a docile pace. Frogs and birds rest on this notably serene crustacean's hard, flat shell while it roams the fresh waters, spearing all manner of river plants and chewing through the fibrous material with its long channel of teeth. Though blind, it has a highly developed sense of taste, able to detect the flora of its specialized diet and the flourishing surface algae. It is through the filtering and consumption of this scum that the ruske both cleanses the water ways for plants to proliferate, and develops its own inner toxins. These toxins suffuse its body, giving its meat an impalpable taste and often lethal digestion, leading this creature to live a safe, if slow life.

traits.name: Peaceful Wader
traits.desc: While the ruske remains motionless in natural bodies of water, it indistinguishable from the surrounding plant life and has Advantage on Stealth checks.

traits.name: Languid
traits.desc: The ruske has Disadvantage on Initiative rolls.

traits.name: Tranquil Ride
traits.desc: While it is treading water, the ruske is unbothered when creatures stand upon on them. The ruske can bear the weight of a medium creature of up to 250 pounds.

defensive_instinct: When suffering a fatal blow, its slow, senseless reactions can keep it moving. Reaction Trigger: When the ruske reaches 0 hit points. Response - Constitution Saving Throw: DC 5 + damage taken from the most recent hit , unless it was a critical hit, the ruske. Success: The ruske drops to 1 Hit Point instead.

actions.name: Chitin Lance
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) Piercing damage. If the ruske swam at least 10+ ft. toward the target immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) Piercing damage.

name: Gurubara
flavor: A curiously common sight in the many rivers throughout the Tanglewood, the peaceful gurabara float down the streams chewing on reed and river fruit along the sun dappled water in absolute contentment. Numerous predators, often prowling right next to the drowsy beasts, barely spare them a glance as they rush down their game trails to savage far more difficult prey. While not impervious to the sudden snapping mandibles of a korrask or the wide ranging slaughter of a nicalliath, the gurubara still remain rather safe in their lackadaisical lifestyle. The key to this mysterious protection is the aquatic algae that proliferates within their fur and stains it a healthy green. Calming pheromones wafts from the algae, cooling tempers and the pangs of hunger of nearby predators.

traits.name: Heightened Snout
traits.desc: The gurubara has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Confident Calm
traits.desc: The gurubara has Disadvantage on Initiative rolls.

traits.name: Innate Peace
traits.desc: Gurubara are immune to the effects of Overwhelming Pacifism.

traits.name: Overwhelming Pacifism
traits.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature in a 30 ft. radius Emanation centered on the gurubara. Failure: Affected creatures act with an dulling sense of pacifism and must refrain from any actions that would be deemed aggressive or malicious. Affected creatures gain Advantage on Wisdom Saving Throws against being Frightened and Charmed. An affected creature may attempt to shake off the effect by attempting the Wisdom Saving Throw again on their turn, and whenever they take damage, the Overwhelming Pacifism effect is lost. A creature that has shaken the effect the creature will not be affected by Overwhelming Pacifism again for 1 day.

actions.name: Reluctant Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) Piercing damage.

reactions.name: Aggressive Pacifism
reactions.desc: Trigger: A creature hits it with an attack roll. Response - Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, the triggering creature. Failure: The attack misses instead.

reactions.name: Wary Instinct
reactions.desc: (1/Day) Fearing the worst when the calming effect has not worked, the rodent panics. Reaction Trigger: When the gurubara is bloodied and in melee combat . Response - Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 12, the gurubara. Success: The gurubara Disengages from combat. The gurubara must repeat the Saving Throw on each of its turns, escaping further until it is passed.

name: Herragath
flavor: Standing tall with crimson feathers and a sinister beaked head, the herragath makes for a terrifying sight on the otherwise placid lake. To those that swim below the water, its red, sky-countering hue is all but unseen. Standing stock-still in the shallows, it waits for the sun to rise to its zenith when the frogs and fish of the Fenlands seek shelter beneath the dark canopy of the lily pads. Dozens of specialized leaf shaped scales spread outwards along its legs, and as prey nestle in close, the herragath will spear its beak downwards, impaling and securing another meal. As such a patient hunter requires absolute stillness, the bird has learned to mimic the surrounding predators, periodically emulating the roars, grunts and calls of fierce beasts to keep the true hunters at a safe distance.

name: Solmundis
flavor: Rising to the height of a large dog, the mud covered salamander slinks through marshes and wetlands, its long sharpened tongue tucked into its odd jaw-less mouth. This amphibian, like its smaller cousins, needs a wet environment to survive and, because of its larger size, often rests in shallow ponds or in the muddy silt of swamps, awaiting the sounds of approaching prey. Evolving a powerful harpoon-like tongue that became too large and long to fit within its mouth, the bottom jaw receded to simple vestigial bones that rest beneath the jaw. When prey draws near, a whip-fast bone edged tongue rips out of the mud, stretching a full 10 feet to impale and embed its barb deeply into the unfortunate creature. Just as quickly, the salamander reels it into its awaiting needle toothed maw.
senses: Tremorsense 60 ft.(when buried in mud), Passive Perception 11

traits.name: Limited Amphibiousness
traits.desc: The solmundis breathes air through its skin, and needs to be submerged in water at least once every four hours to avoid drying out and suffocating.

traits.name: Ambush Predator
traits.desc: The solmundis has Advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has Surprised.

traits.name: Shallows Stealth
traits.desc: When the solmundis remains motionless while submerged in mud, water, or a similar environmental feature, it gains Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

traits.name: Aggressive Instinct (1/Day)
traits.desc: The solmundis can dart its tongue in quick succession.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The solmundis makes two attacks with its Toothy Maw, Webbed Tail, and Tongue Harpoon in any combination.

actions.name: Toothy Maw
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6+1) Piercing damage. If the target creature has the Restrained condition from the solmundis' Tongue Harpoon, it deals an additional 3 (1d6) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Webbed Tail
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6+1) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Tongue Harpoon
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +3 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d6+1) Piercing damage. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 12, one Medium or smaller creature the solmundis has successfully hit with its Tongue Harpoon. Failure: Target has the Restrained condition (escape DC 12) and takes 2 (1d4) Piercing damage on each of the solmundis' turns until the harpoon is removed. The solmundis cannot use its Tongue Harpoon while currently grappling a creature.

reactions.name: Aggressive Instinct
reactions.desc: Trigger: When the solmundis fails to hit with its Tongue Harpoon Attack. Response - Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11, the original target for the Tongue Harpoon attack. Failure: 7 (2d6) Slashing damage. Success: Half damage.

name: Baughur
flavor: Wading through the thick muck and mire of the Fenlands, the baughur looks to be nothing less than a small fleshy island when breaching the water. Flies and birds orbit its thick hide as it shovels its tusked face into the thick sediment, its prehensile snout seeking out aquatic root vegetables. Often quite calm and docile when in their dozens-strong drove of close kin, the baughur will attempt to sink to the bottom of the marsh when confronted by any terrestrial creature threat. Only resorting to violence with their goring tusks when protecting their young or spotting their most hated rivals in the Fenlands, the pebbleback auhk. Often standing their ground with a display of loud splashes and deep-barreled chest grunts.

traits.name: Sensitive Ears
traits.desc: The baughur has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.

traits.name: Deep Wallower
traits.desc: The baughur can hold its breath for up to 40 minutes without needing to take a breath.

traits.name: Waterborne
traits.desc: The baughur has Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made while underwater.

defensive_instinct: Defensive Instinct (1/Day) When a friendly baughur it can hear within 60 ft. of it is slain. On its turn, Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 14, the baughur. Success: The baughur gains Resistance to Piercing and Slashing damage for the duration of the combat encounter, and is unable to perform Disengage actions while in combat until all enemies within 60 ft. are slain or incapacitated.

actions.name: Piercing Gore
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Thick Toed Stomp
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage.

reactions.name: Bloodied Waters
reactions.desc: Trigger: When damage reduces the baughur to 0 Hit Points. Response - Constitution Saving Throw: DC 5 + damage taken from the most recent hit, unless it's from a Critical Hit. Success: The baughur drops to 1 hit point instead.

name: Glomunder
flavor: In the muck of the Mirewynn swamps, a dorsal fan breaches the water as a powerful tail churns the calm surface. The glomunder does not make for a subtle hunter, yet even so, many larger predators keep their distance unless desperate, as the large frog-like creature has a means of protection wholly unique to the swamps. When cornered by a voracious predator, it will swing its head violently, splashing a viscous saliva from its two sinuous tendrils that whip back and forth as it tries to slap and spread a debilitating neurotoxin. Once in contact with this thick yellow fluid, extremities fall numb and limp and, before long, the afflicted creature finds itself sinking into the stagnant water, incapacitated and an easy meal for the amphibious glomunder.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The glomunder can breathe both air and water.

traits.name: Bipedal Leap
traits.desc: The glomunder's long jump is up to 20 ft. and its high jump is up to 10 ft., with or without a running start.

traits.name: Swamp Born
traits.desc: While in the Fenlands or equivalent environment, the glomunder has Advantage on Athletics and Dexterity rolls.

defensive_instinct: Defensive Instinct (1/Day) Frenzied and hurt, the glomunder flails desperately. Reaction Trigger: When the glomunder is bloodied and in melee combat. Response - Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 12, the glomunder. The glomunder lashes out with its Paralytic Whips and makes an attack roll against the nearest enemy creature if within range.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The glomunder makes two attacks with its Lashing Tail, Toothless Bite, and Paralytic Whips in any combination.

actions.name: Lashing Tail
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll : +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4+3) Bludgeoning damage. Strength Saving Throw: DC 13, Medium or smaller creature that the glomunder has successfully hit with its Lashing Tail attack. Failure: Target has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Toothless Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll : +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6+3) Piercing damage. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 11, creature that the glomunder has successfully hit with its Toothless Bite attack. Failure: Target has the Paralyzed condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 3 minutes, it succeeds automatically.

actions.name: Paralytic Whips
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll : +4 to hit, reach 10ft., one target. 4 (1d4+2) Bludgeoning damage. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 11, creature that the glomunder has successfully hit with its Paralytic Whips attack. Failure: Target has the Paralyzed condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 3 minutes, it succeeds automatically.

reactions.name: Defensive Instinct Lash
reactions.desc: Trigger: When the glomunder is bloodied and in melee combat. Response - Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 12, the glomunder. The glomunder lashes out with its Paralytic Whips and makes an attack roll against the nearest enemy creature if within range.

name: Larkiera
flavor: In the dappled, sullen green light of a wide river, a predator slides through the tall water grass on the hunt. Its long sleek body swimming silently, its peculiar crescent-shaped pupils seeking movement in the vertical kelp forest, as well as discerning any variation in color that breaks through the deep greenery. Throughout the sullen day the larkiera patrol the long rivers that stretch through the Wealdwoods, the dark of the canopy above suiting their stalking behavior. Though an effective hunter with its trap-like teeth and agile maneuverability, the larkiera is far from the top of the Fenland's trophic food-chain, and so it protects itself with a quickly lashing tail and dozens of dorsal spines that deter larger threats from immediately attacking it.

traits.name: Water Breathing
traits.desc: The larkiera can breathe only underwater.

traits.name: Aquatic Ambusher
traits.desc: If the larkiera Surprises a creature and hits it with a Piercing Teeth attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) Piercing damage.

traits.name: Aggressive Instinct (1/Day)
traits.desc: When Bloodied and in melee combat. On its turn, Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 12, the larkiera. Success: The larkiera whips its barbed tail around, dealing 5 (1d10) Slashing damage in a 5 ft. wide Emanation originating from the larkiera.

traits.name: Barbed Hide
traits.desc: Any creature that grapples the larkiera takes 5 (1d10) Piercing damage from the barbs along its back at the start of the larkiera's turn.

actions.name: Piercing Teeth
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6+3) Piercing damage.

name: Murrow
flavor: Within the gloomy silt of the Fenlands' most stagnant waters, the blind murrow moves with the certainty of a vicious hunter. With a snout covered in barbels, sensitive to the electromagnetic pulses of the heartbeat and movement of nearby fauna, the fish can sense prey with lethal ease. Rising slowly, its sullen flesh blending with the murk, the lilotoal that sits contently above the water, barely perceiving the looming threat below, cannot hop away in time as the lily pad and surrounding water is suddenly sucked into the engulfing wide maw of the hungry fish. Filling its gullet, the large catfish sinks down, deep into to the thick mud, digesting and momentarily satisfied.

name: Fennfistle
flavor: Webbed feet step gently over the marsh lily pads as the lanky fennfi stle searches for its favored meal, eggs. Th is opportunistic ovivore keeps a gold-flecked eye out for either bird eggs nested within the rushes and cattails along the shore, or for the glimmerings of the ovoid shapes of amphibian and fi sh eggs beneath the surface. Its long sinuous neck perfectly adapted to quickly gulp down its prize into an expandable, horned gular and rush off before any protective parent or nearby predator can catch this nimble beast. With wide webbed toes and bounding jumps, it leaps across rivers and ponds. Th is amphibian is perfectly adapted to the damp environments of the Fenlands and can outpace any creature that ventures into its swampy home. Brightly colored scales adorn the creature's face, both as a display of sexual maturity and to guard it slightly from the scratching talons of protective birds. A long sinuous forked tail distracts guarding parents of bird nests, as its ends resemble delectable worms. A lithe body and strong nimble legs allow the amphibian to quickly evade predators over the muddy paths and shallow depths of the marshes.

traits.name: Fenland Stalker
traits.desc: Th e fennfi stle can hold its breath for 10 minutes.

traits.name: Bounding Leap
traits.desc: Th e fennfi stle's long jump is up to 25 ft. and its high jump is up to 15 ft., with or without a running start.

traits.name: Leaping Strike
traits.desc: If the fennfi stle attacks a creature within 5 ft. of it immediately after landing from a jump, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) Bludgeoning damage.

defensive_instinct: Defensive Instinct (3/Day) If the fennfi stle is within 5 ft. of more than one hostile creatures who can see it and aren't incapacitated. On its turn, Wisdom Saving Th row: DC 10 , the fennfi stle. Success: Th e fennfi stle makes a Whipping Tail attack against an enemy creature as a Bonus Action, in an effort to put distance between itself and its aggressors.

actions.name: Toothed Gulp
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll : +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit : 12 (3d6+4) Piercing damage. Strength Saving Th row: DC 12, target Small or smaller creature that the fennfi stle has successfully hit with its Toothed Gulp. Failure: Th e target is swallowed. A swallowed creature has the Blinded and Restrained Condition, has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the fennfi stle , and takes 2 (1d6) Acid damage at the start of each of the fennfi stle 's turns. If the fennfi stle takes 10 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the fennfi stle must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution Saving Th row at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 5 ft. of the fennfi stle and has the Prone condition. If the fennfi stle dies, any swallowed creatures no longer have the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse using 5 ft. of movement, exiting Prone. Th e fennfi stle can swallow up to 2 Small creatures at a time.

actions.name: Whipping Tail
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll : +6 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit : 11 (2d8+4) Bludgeoning damage. Strength Saving Th row: DC 10, one Large or smaller creature the fennfi stle has successfully hit with its Whipping Tail. Failure: Th e target is pushed back 5 ft..

name: Rauka
flavor: A spray of exhaled breath reveals the tusked gray head of a rauka rising from the brackish water of a river delta. Th is territorial omnivore glares over the tumultuous water with beady eyes as its thick jowls clench, chewing the river grass it had swam below to gather. Roaming in slow moving herds of dozens of individuals, these aggressive mammals often clear out large expanses of the river mouth from any competing creatures, as most do not want to contend with the shearing tusks that twist out from their blunt heads, capable of goring and puncturing both hide and thick shell with ease. Th ough aquatic, they have been known to attack any terrestrial aggressors with a surprisingly violent charge, erupting onto the beach in short bursts, their strong forelimbs pulling their heavy bulk into a lethal range.

traits.name: Coastal Diver
traits.desc: Th e rauka can hold its breath for 30 minutes.

traits.name: Deep Grazer
traits.desc: Th e rauka has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell but has Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

defensive_instinct: Aggressive Instinct (1/Day) When Bloodied and in melee combat. On its turn, Constitution Saving Th row: DC 15 , the rauka. Success: Th e rauka gains Advantage on its next Goring Tusk attack roll.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Th e rauka makes two attacks with its Goring Tusks and Hulking Flippers in any combination.

actions.name: Goring Tusks
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) Slashing damage. If the rauka swims 10+ ft. toward the target immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Hulking Flippers
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d12 + 3) Bludgeoning damage.

name: Silvette
flavor: From white rapids rise a pair of horns as a silvette races upstream following the scent of blood still fresh in the rushing waters. Th ese scavengers, armored in plates of overlapping scales reminiscent of a fi sh from a bygone era, battle with larkiera and nicalliath for recent kills. To contend with such competition, razored protrusions along their face and hardened scales protect them while they wrestle for hunks of meat. Lacking the patience of an ambush predator, these fi sh instead migrate great distances, attacking every fi sh and amphibian they can smell, with in an unshaken faith in the protection of their armored scales. While this aggressive behavior has seen this species spread through much of the Fenlands, many larger predators have taken advantage of the mindless brute.

traits.name: River Born
traits.desc: Th e silvette can breathe only underwater.

traits.name: Blood Scent
traits.desc: Th e silvette has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell within water, and can sense the presence and location of spilled blood within 500 ft..

defensive_instinct: Aggressive Instinct (1/Day) Always ready to move, the silvette responds quickly when hit. Reaction Trigger: When the silvette is hit with a ranged attack Response - Wisdom Saving Th row: DC 10, the silvette. Success: It moves towards the attacking creature and makes a Razored Scale Melee attack roll. Th is Reaction doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when the silvette swims out of an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Th e silvette makes two attacks with its Curved Toothed Bite, and Razored Scales in any combination.

actions.name: Curved Toothed Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target creature is size Large or larger, the silvette has Advantage on the attack roll.

actions.name: Razored Scales
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Slashing damage. If the silvette swam 30+ ft. toward the target immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) Slashing damage. Strength Saving Th row: DC 14, target Medium or smaller creature that the silvette has successfully hit. Failure: Target creature is pushed into a unoccupied space 5 ft. away.

name: Pebbleback Auhk
flavor: In small, tightly knit herds of a dozen kin, the pebbleback auhk wallows in the Fenlands, chewing marsh plants and digging up mollusks to chew on their shells for the rich calcium they require to build up their namesake's bony plates. Th ough rather slow grazing beasts, predators keep a wary distance from them, for not only does their bony overlapping osteoderms give them a measure of protection from claw and tooth, their wide hardened horns can batter any would-be hunter into a muddy red ruin. While not particularly aggressive, there's a certain obstinate movement in how they claim their wetland territories, sometimes even physically pushing baughur out of fertile swamps, relying on their armored hide to defend against any irritated, retaliatory tusked charges. Males sport a wide crest of horns, while the females themselves have a hardened forehead plate. Used to deter predators, the auhk can bludgeon and crush wouldbe predators with ease, protecting their young and feeding grounds. Wide and squat limbs wade through the Fenlands tirelessly, their four toed feet end in hoof-like nails that allow a strong grip in algae and mud-thick waters.

traits.name: Grazers Senses
traits.desc: Th e pebbleback auhk has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell, and Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

traits.name: Herds Presence
traits.desc: Th e pebbleback auhk gains a +1 bonus to its Armor Class (total AC 19) when another allied pebbleback auhk that it can see is next to it within 5 ft..

defensive_instinct: Defensive Instinct (4/Day) Strained and bleeding, the pebbleback auhk stands fi rm. Reaction Trigger: When the pebbleback auhk is bloodied and in melee combat . Response - Constitution Saving Th row: DC 14, the pebbleback auhk. Success: Th e pebbleback auhk gains +1 bonus to its Armor Class (total AC 19) for the duration of the combat encounter (which can stack with Herds Presence).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Th e pebbleback auhk makes two attacks with its Crest Ram and Lumbering Bulk in any combination.

actions.name: Crest Ram
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit : 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. If target is a Medium or smaller creature and the pebbleback auhk moved 20+ ft. straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Lumbering Bulk
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit : 8 (1d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. Strength Saving Th row: DC 16, Medium or smaller creature that the pebbleback auhk has successfully hit with its Lumbering Bulk attack. Failure: Target is pushed back to an adjacent empty space 10 ft. away from the pebbleback auhk.

name: Nuthorghull
flavor: The apex predator of the Fenlands, this massive amphibian lurks in the deepest lakes and widest rivers. It grows to monumental sizes, adapted to millions of years of island isolation, its presence making other megafauna wary. With whisker-like barbels, it quests in the muck for prey, ready to engulf any submerged creature with its gaping maw. Short, stocky limbs allow it to drag its heavy weight out of water for short distances.

bio.niche: Amphibious Apex Carnivore Preys upon Baughur, Fennfistle, Larkiera, Murrow, Nicalliath, Pebbleback Auhk, Rauka, Ruske, Silvette

senses: Darkvision 30 ft., Tremorsense 60 ft., Passive Perception 17

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the nuthorghull fails a Saving Throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The nuthorghull can breathe both air and water through its skin, but it needs to be submerged in water at least once every 3 hours to avoid drying out and suffocating.

traits.name: Sensitive Barbels
traits.desc: The nuthorghull has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks while underwater.

traits.name: Aquatic Dominion
traits.desc: While submerged, the nuthorghull has Advantage on attack rolls against creatures without a swim speed.

traits.name: Muddy Behemoth
traits.desc: The nuthorghull has Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made while it is underwater.

defensive_instinct: When Bloodied. On its turn, Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, the nuthorghull. Success: The nuthorghull gains +1 bonus to its Armor Class (total AC 20) and Resistance to Slashing for the duration of the combat encounter.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The nuthorghull makes three attacks, using Sweeping Tail, Cranial Ram, or Engulfing Maw in any combination.

actions.name: Sweeping Tail
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +11 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10+6) Bludgeoning damage. Strength Saving Throw: DC 16, one Large or smaller creature the nuthorghull has successfully hit with its Sweeping Tail. Failure: The target is pushed back 10 ft. and has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Cranial Ram
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) Bludgeoning damage. If the nuthorghull swam 20+ ft. straight toward the target creature immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 5 (1d10) Bludgeoning damage and is pushed back 5 ft..

actions.name: Engulfing Maw
actions.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 18, each creature in a 30 ft. Cone. Failure: If the creature is Large or smaller, it is swallowed. A swallowed creature has the Blinded and Restrained Conditions, has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the nuthorghull, and takes 10 (3d6) Acid damage at the start of each of the nuthorghull's turns. If the nuthorghull takes 36 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the nuthorghull must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution Saving Throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 5 ft. of the nuthorghull and unless underwater, has the Prone condition. If the nuthorghull dies, any swallowed creatures no longer have the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse using 5 ft. of movement, exiting Prone. The nuthorghull can swallow up to one Large creature (or six Medium creatures or ten Small creatures) at a time.

actions.name: Voracious (Bonus Action)
actions.desc: The nuthorghull can move up to its swim speed toward a hostile creature that it can see.

name: Fennfistle Tadpole
flavor: Hundreds of little fennfistle tadpoles hatch from their cluster of eggs and swim towards the safety under the shade at the river's edge instinctively. Hiding beneath lily pads and slow moving ruske, they dart out to attack minnow and other minuscule fish. When confronted with larger creatures, they are quick to scurry and batter away the more persistent ones with their tails.

bio.niche: Preys upon minnow and other minuscule fish.

traits.name: Aquatic Infancy
traits.desc: The fennfistle tadpole can breathe only underwater.

traits.name: Darting Movement
traits.desc: The fennfistle tadpole doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it swims out of an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Finned Tail
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 Bludgeoning damage. Strength Saving Throw: DC 10, one Tiny creature the fennfistle tadpole has successfully hit with its Whipping Tail. Failure: The target is pushed back 5 ft..

actions.name: Splutter
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: Target creature gets splashed with 1 pint of water.

name: Solmundis Paedomorph
flavor: Listening intently for the vibrations of larger animals, the little amphibians group together for safety in the thick mud of the river bank. Only after hours of nothing but the buzz of insects will they venture out into the water and try their best to harpoon unwary frogs and fish, practicing for the lethal aim they'll need to survive into adulthood.
senses: Passive Perception 10, Tremorsense 60 ft. (while buried in the mud)

traits.name: Limited Amphibiousness
traits.desc: The solmundis paedomorph breathes air through its skin, but it needs to be submerged in water at least once every four hours to avoid drying out and suffocating.

traits.name: Shallows Stealth
traits.desc: When the solmundis paedomorph remains motionless while submerged in mud, water, or a similar environmental feature, it gains Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

actions.name: Bladed Tongue
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4+3) Piercing damage.

name: Gurubara Pup
flavor: Wading in the water as close as possible to their herd, the first few seasons of a gurubara's life is when it is at its most fraught with danger. Since the calming algae has yet to bloom within its short fur, the pups look to be the most delectable of prey, and any careless wandering young gurubara can quickly find themselves snatched up by the many predators that haunt these lethal waters.

traits.name: Heightened Snout
traits.desc: The gurubara pup has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Innate Peace
traits.desc: The gurubara pup is immune to the effects of Overwhelming Pacifism.

traits.name: Confident Calm
traits.desc: The gurubara pup has Disadvantage on Initiative rolls.

actions.name: Reluctant Nip
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 Piercing damage.

actions.name: Scurry (Bonus Action)
actions.desc: The gurubara pup can take a Dash, Disengage or Hide action on each of its turns as a Bonus action.

name: Pebbleback Calf
flavor: Curious and excited about every new experience that the Fenlands have to offer, a pebbleback calf is a stark contrast from the more dour and stoic adults. With their pebble-like osteoderms not fully developed, the young mammal cannot yet withstand the bite of many predators and, so, relies on its agility to escape and rush back to the safety of its herd.

traits.name: Grazers Senses
traits.desc: The pebbleback auhk has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell, and Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Crest Nudge
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 Bludgeoning Damage. If target is a Medium or smaller creature and the pebbleback calf moved 20+ ft. straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target is pushed 5 ft..

actions.name: Safety in Numbers (Bonus Action)
actions.desc: The pebbleback calf can move up to its speed toward a friendly creature it can smell.

name: Laststep Lily
flavor: A behemoth amongst others of its kind, this carnivorous lily pad rests on the water looking to be a firm and stable step to cross rivers with ease, its thick fibrous leaves nearly raft-like in their structure. This is all but a feint, the moment a sizable animal steps up on its surface, sweat-like beads of sticky sap spread across its surface and the leaf twists itself downwards in a tight spiral, pulling its catch below. For weeks it will remain under the surface, digesting its cocooned prey slowly.

traits.name: Trap Space
traits.desc: The large laststep lily floats on ponds and lakes surrounded by regular water lilies. The laststep lily is a circular plant taking up a 5 ft. Circle.

traits.name: Countering
traits.desc: While it looks like regular water lilies, its larger size is a clear indication of its species. Wisdom (Perception) Check: DC 8. Success: The Natural Trap is identified.

reactions.name: Numbing Tendrils
reactions.desc: Trigger: When a creature steps within its Trap Space. Response - Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 14, the creature that triggered the Trap. Failure: The target is pulled underwater and has the Restrained condition (escape DC 10).

name: Wriggleweed
flavor: The long grasping strands of wriggleweed, curling on themselves like the tentacles of a cephalopod hold fast against other plants and fish with an iron grip. Not to consume, but to simply grow and spread, soaking in as much of the sun that it can underneath the water. While not intentionally aggressive, the reactive grass has been known to drown many wading creatures, pulling them beneath the surface and into the silt and mud below.

traits.name: Trap Space
traits.desc: Across a wide swath of lake or river bottom grows a small forest of wriggleweed, taking up a 10 ft. cube of space.

traits.name: Countering
traits.desc: These thin dark green leaves are difficult to see as they flow with the water and other sea grasses. Wisdom (Perception) Check: DC 18. Success: The Natural Trap is identified.

reactions.name: Grasping Grass
reactions.desc: Trigger: When a creature enters its Trap Space below the water. Response - Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 12, the creature that triggered the Trap. Failure: The target has the Restrained condition. As an action, a creature Restrained by the wriggleweed can try to escape from them, doing so with a successful DC 12 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check.

name: Fenfall Fungus
flavor: A slurry of mud and a submerged column of thousands upon thousands of minute criss-crossing threads of mycelium make up this fungus. The brown and green root-like structures while individually weak, are capable of pulling in unison, gripping and dragging biological matter into its depths.

bio.niche: Trap, grips and drags biological matter.

traits.name: Trap Space
traits.desc: An unassuming patch of wet mud, measuring a 10 ft. Circle disguises the thousands of mycelium strands that tunnel down 30 ft. into the soft earth.

traits.name: Countering
traits.desc: Indistinguishable from regular mud, only the lack of plant growth belies its lethal nature. Wisdom (Perception) Check: DC 21. Success: The Natural Trap is identified.

reactions.name: Devouring Mycelium
reactions.desc: Trigger: When a creature enters its Trap Space. Response - Strength Saving Throw: DC 16, the creature that triggered the Trap. Failure: The creature begins to sink 1d4 + 3 ft. into the fenfall fungus and has the Restrained condition. At the start of each of the creature's turns, it sinks another 1d4 ft.. As long as the creature isn't completely submerged in fenfall fungus, it can take an Action to try to escape, doing so with a successful Strength (Athletics) check DC 10 plus the number of feet the creature has sunk into the fungus. A creature that is completely submerged in the fungus has Total Cover and the Blinded condition and risks suffocation. A creature can pull another creature within its reach out of the fungus by taking an action and succeeding on a Strength (Athletics) check DC 5 plus the number of feet the creature has sunk into the fungus. Failing any attempt to escape sinks the creature another 1d4 ft.

name: Blood Twine
flavor: Like spilled blood, the algae sits on the surface of stagnant ponds and lakes. Small fibers, lined with a layer of proteases and hydrolyze enzymes break down proteins and other organic compounds that come in contact with it. A raft-like mass that floats on the water absorbs the nutrients, growing and dividing smaller progeny as a form of asexual reproduction to cover more of the water's surface.

bio.niche: Carnivorous algae, breaks down organic compounds.
bio.biome: Still water surfaces such as ponds and lakes

traits.name: Trap Space
traits.desc: The carnivorous algae grows on still water surfaces such as ponds and lakes, spread out roughly in 5 ft. Circle.

traits.name: Countering
traits.desc: The red filaments that rise from the water are quite striking to a knowing Traveler. Wisdom (Perception) Check: DC 8. Success: The Natural Trap is identified.

reactions.name: Red Feast
reactions.desc: Trigger: When a creature enters its Trap Space. Response - Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15, the creature that triggered the Trap. Failure: 7 (2d6) Acid damage at the start of each of the triggering creatures turns for as long as the creature is within the algae Trap Space.

name: Burberry Beetle
flavor: Th e humble burberry beetle gingerly walks along the branch of a burberry tree to safely hide amongst the leaves. Th is diminutive insect, which spends most of the year camouflaged safely among the lower foliage, climbs high as the warm seasons wane. While the natural berries of the tree are found shriveled on the branch, the insect brandishes similarly shaped and vibrant orbs to entice migrating birds to dart in and consume the false fruit. Nestled within the digestive tracks of the bird, the burberry beetle larvae stay dormant throughout the winter and travel great distances within the avian migrations, waiting until the warmth of spring to then emerge in their droppings, crawling forth for a new year and new cycle of life. While the beetle is rather small and harmless, the leaves of the burberry tree in which its diet entirely subsists on, builds up a toxin in its body that can be fatal to many predators. A long sail of branching ovipositors rises over the insect's thorax, acting as both a camouflaged mimicry of its natural home of tree leaves, and a safe method to the eggs far from the core of its body from any potentially aggressively hungry birds.

traits.name: Forest Critter
traits.desc: Th e burberry beetle has Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to Hide while in the Wealdwoods or equivalent environments.

traits.name: Beetle Bounce
traits.desc: Th e burberry beetle's long jump is up to 10 ft. and its high jump is up to 10 ft., with or without a running start.

traits.name: Nimble Legs
traits.desc: If the burberry beetle succeeds on a Dexterity Saving Th row, it takes no damage from effects that would deal half damage on Success.

traits.name: Burberries
traits.desc: Th e red eggs that stem from the insect can be plucked off with a DC 10 Dexterity check without harming the insect. Each burberry beetle carries 1d8 Burberries. Burberries stay fresh for 1 Day. You may only experience the effects of 1 Burberry per day. When consumed, roll a 1d20 and consult the results below for the immediate effect. - 1 Take 11 (2d10) Poison damage. - 2-5 Take 5 (1d10) Poison damage. - 6-8 No results, but it tastes terrible. - 9-10 No results, but it tastes wonderful. - 11-15 Heal for 1d10 HP. - 16-19 Benefi t from the effects of a Short Rest. - 20 Benefi t from the effects of a Long Rest.

defensive_instinct: Wary Instinct (1/Day) When in melee combat. On its turn, Wisdom Saving Th row: DC 10 , the burberry beetle. Success: Th e burberry beetle makes a Disengage action with a Beetle Bounce 20 ft. jump.

actions.name: Leaf Cutting Nip
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4) + 4 Piercing damage.

reactions.name: Twiggy Leap
reactions.desc: Trigger: When an another creature moves with 5 ft. of the Burberry Beetle. Response: Th e burberry beetle can hop a short distance, allowing it to move up to 20 ft. in any direction. Th e burberry beetle doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it jumps out of an enemy's reach.

name: Gomitoad
flavor: With strong lithe limbs and large elongated body, the gomitoad leaps from branch to branch in search of camouflaged leaf insects to pounce upon and feast. Living a rather fearless existence for a toad, its brightly colored body warns predators of their toxin-laden skin which works for most, except scavick, who can survive the lethal lunegrove toxin in small doses. Both male and female toads aggressively guard a single tree, wrestling with rival toads with their set of two frontal horns. Unlike most amphibians, the gomitoad has evolved to live in the canopy far from bodies of water. It keeps its body moist in rain water collected in leaves, and when the drier seasons approach, will dig divots in the tree bark to collect rain water to keep itself hydrated. Thickened dorsal plates and two horns crest the head of gomitoads. Used primarily to fight off rivals from feeding grounds and during mating season. Gomitoad lay their clutch of eggs in leaf litter, often high in a tree-crotch. Lacking the calcium of avian and reptilian eggs, these soft-gel eggs safeguard the growing tadpole within with the use of dew-catching rents that run along the sides and top.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: Th e gomitoad can breathe both air and water.

traits.name: Bounding Hop
traits.desc: Th e gomitoad can jump up to 20 ft. horizontally and 10 ft. vertically, without the need of a running start.

traits.name: Aposematism
traits.desc: Th e gomitoad has Disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide.

defensive_instinct: Wary Instinct (1/Day) Once the gomitoad is engaged in combat. On its turn, Wisdom Saving Th row: DC 10, the gomitoad. Success: It croaks out loudly as a Free Action. All other gomitoads within 100 ft. are immediately alerted and escape the vicinity.

actions.name: Toxic Tackle
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit : 4 (1d4 + 2) Bludgeoning damage. If any exposed flesh is touched by the gomitoad from this attack, the target will suffer from Lunegrove Toxin.

reactions.name: Lunegrove Toxin
reactions.desc: Trigger: A creature comes in contact or hits it with an attack roll. Response - Constitution Saving Th row: DC 14, the triggering creature. Failure: Target takes 3 (1d6) Poison damage and has the Poisoned condition from the Lunegrove Toxin. Th e target may repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 5 minutes, it succeeds automatically. While Poisoned, on its turn, the creature is compelled to attack the nearest creature, friend or foe.

name: Frondilli
flavor:
Encountering Wary of any and all other creatures, the frondilli will either flee long before being seen or hide in the underbrush using its natural camouflage. Outside of the mating months an adult deer will often be found grazing alone or in pairs if they are caring for young fawn. It is possible for a Traveler to lure a frondilli with the rich aroma of syrups or sap, but it will quickly escape from the slightest sign of danger.

Hardened exposed bone sheaths the sides of the frondilli's jaw. Allowing the deer to dig into tree bark quickly and lap up the thickly dripping sap

Covered in specialized waxy hairs that mimic leaves, the color of the frondilli fur changes from rich greens in spring, to warm oranges during fall, and finally a grayish brown during winter. All the better to hide in the season shifting Wealdwoods

Thick sap runs through the northern trees in Sol'Kesh, providing a rich and sugary diet for the swift and nimble deer

traits.name: Tense Senses
traits.desc: The frondilli has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing and smell.

traits.name: Nimble Hoofed
traits.desc: The frondilli does not provoke Attacks of Opportunity when it moves out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Wary Instinct
traits.desc: Fearful and skittish, the frondilli will flee at a moment's notice from danger. Reaction Trigger: When the frondilli is engaged in combat. Response - Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 15, the frondilli. Success: The frondilli Disengages from combat immediately, using its full movement speed to move away from any enemies.

traits.name: Skittish
traits.desc: If the frondilli is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity Saving Throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage on a success and half damage on a failure.

traits.name: Wealdwoodland Fur
traits.desc: The frondilli can attempt the Hide Action even when only lightly obscured by foliage, and has Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made while in the proximity to trees or bushes.

actions.name: Razored Jaw
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll : +5 to hit, reach 5ft., one target. Hit : 5 (1d4 + 3) Slashing damage.

reactions.name: Wary Instinct Reaction
reactions.desc: Trigger: When the frondilli is engaged in combat. Response - Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 15, the frondilli. Success: The frondilli Disengages from combat immediately, using its full movement speed to move away from any enemies.

name: Calitross
flavor:
In the northern wilds of Sol'Kesh, high amongst the colossal conifers of Last Bloom, the calitross silently climbs. Th is avian creature, having long lost its ability to fly, uses its long limbs to quietly stalk the boughs and cliff crags instead, gathering berries, and if lucky, scavenging recent kills. Surviving in the harsh northern climate has made this versatile omnivore one of the more intelligent creatures in Sol'Kesh, living in small flocks of a dozen family members they have a developed rich vocabulary of chirps, cries and bird song to warn each other of incoming predators, like the basilospri and lexati. Together the flock can distract larger predators to scavenge from their kill, create communal stores of nuts for the colder seasons, and protect their terrestrial fledglings for the next generation.

Encountering Quietly climbing overhead in the heights of conifers trees, fi nding a calitross is no easy feat and with superb eyesight and hearing, they can often sense approaching danger. One method to lure them is out to hang freshly killed carcasses over high branches. Although the avian creatures are often smart enough to suspect something, the allure of an easy meal can override their suspicion.

With a large cranium and ability to primitively communicate, the calitross may be one of the more intelligent creatures inhabiting the island of Sol'Kesh

A long feathered tail, akin to a felines, gives the calitross a measured balance when climbing

After eons of evolution, the phalanges have regressed to a more digit-like form, with a curved claw tipping each to allow agile climbing

bio.niche: Generalist Omnivore Arboreal Scavenger Preyed upon by Basilospri, Lexati, Skyelarx, Vinnirex,Ynnil · Preys on Burberry Beetles, Dartiguan, Lhoupin

traits.name: Wealdwoods Ambusher
traits.desc: The calitross has Advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has Surprised.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.desc: Due to its highly developed syrinx, the calitross can mimic certain sounds it has heard. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 12 Wisdom (Survival) or Intelligence (Nature) check.

traits.name: Wary Instinct (1/Day)
traits.desc: Fearing for its own life, the calitross will flee higher into the trees when hurt. Reaction Trigger: When the calitross is Bloodied. Response Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 12, the calitross. Success: The calitross Disengages away from combat. The calitross must repeat the Saving Throw on each of its turns, escaping further until it has passed.

traits.name: Flock Tactics
traits.desc: The calitross has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the Calitross' allies are within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Tree Scaler
traits.desc: The calitross can climb diffi cult vertical surfaces, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Resistance
traits.desc: Cold

actions.name: Curved Beak
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll : +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8+3) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Talons
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll : +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (3d4+3) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Antagonizing Screech
actions.desc: (Recharge 4-6) Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature in a 15 ft. Cone. Failure: 4 (1d8) Thunder damage and get the Deafened condition for one minute. Success: Half damage.

reactions.name: Wary Instinct Reaction
reactions.desc: Trigger: When the calitross is Bloodied. Response Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 12, the calitross. Success: The calitross Disengages away from combat. The calitross must repeat the Saving Throw on each of its turns, escaping further until it has passed.

name: Crested Quill Pack
flavor:
Flitting through the forest understory, the crested quill displays an unusual pack hunting technique. With their spring-like legs, the small swarm synchronously launches themselves at flying birds, their sharp mandibles piercing hide and bringing down prey much larger than themselves. While descended from locusts, these insects do not amass in swarms thousands strong, but instead group together in swarms of their original spawning. Th ese spawn-kin spend most of their lives hunting together until they chance upon the spawn-kin of another, through an array of mesmerizing dances the two swarms will form and split, exchanging males to breed and propagate further swarms to patrol the Wealdwoods.

Encountering A lone crested quill and one living in a pack have two very different behaviors. When alone they act much like any other insect, mostly consisting on carrion and flitting away at the nearest disturbance. When in their spawning pack, a more cunning instinct overtakes them, and they act synchronously when flitting through the understory in search of a prey to ambush.

bio.niche: Specialist Ambush Pack Carnivore Preyed upon by Calitross, Gomitoad, Scavick · Preys on Aristo Doves, Dartiguan, Maedrynn

subtype: Medium Swarm of Tiny Beasts, Unaligned, Defensive

traits.name: Resistances
traits.desc: Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing

traits.name: Vulnerabilities
traits.desc: Fire, Thunder

traits.name: Immunities
traits.desc: Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrifi ed, Prone, Restrained, Stunned

traits.name: Underfoot Camouflage
traits.desc: The crested quill pack has Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made while in the Wealdwoods or equivalent environment.

traits.name: Wary Instinct (1/Day)
traits.desc: Broken and shattered the remaining Crested Quill desperately call out for aid. Reaction Trigger: Once the Crested Quill Pack is reduced to 0 hit points. Response - Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 12. Success: A remaining wounded crested quill calls out into the Wealdwoods for reinforcements and the swarm's Hit Point is replenished by 7 (2d6).

traits.name: Spawn Pack
traits.desc: The pack can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the pack can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny insect.

actions.name: Pincer
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. Hit: 9 (2d6+3) Piercing damage, or 6 (1d6+3) Piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer. If the swarm moved 10+ ft. straight toward the target immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 3 (1d6) Piercing damage.

reactions.name: Wary Instinct Reaction
reactions.desc: Trigger: Once the Crested Quill Pack is reduced to 0 hit points. Response - Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 12. Success: A remaining wounded crested quill calls out into the Wealdwoods for reinforcements and the swarm's Hit Point is replenished by 7 (2d6).

name: Lexati
flavor:
With furred arms outstretched, the lexati glides from the mountain cliffs to skim over the wide open Wealdwoods canopy, a sunlit world untouched by the crawling competition and mayhem below. Skillfully snatching birds and large flying insects mid flight and feasting on the fruits of the highest branches. Unfortunately, a handful of predators can dispel this arboreal paradise with the gliding mammal often having to dodge the acidic streams of ynnil spittle or the claws of skyelarx and basilospri. Th ese amiable felines are often found in familial clowders playfully bounding along the tops of the trees. Th ough incapable of true flight, the lexati can rise to great heights by riding warm updrafts to nest in safer, harder to reach areas amongst communal roosts in the treetops or cliff face ledges.

Encountering To those Travelers with a penchant for climbing, these highly social and intelligent creatures often respond with curiosity when a new creature enters their aerial domain. Th ough the group will respond amiably to offerings of fruit, any form of aggression or violence to their kind will be communicated to the whole colony, having them flee on sight, or attack en mass.

bio.niche: Specialized Aerial Omnivore Preyed upon by Basilospri, Skyelarx, Tyrandroth, Ynnil · Preys upon - Burberry Beetle, Dartiguan, Drafi an

traits.name: Wealdwood Senses
traits.desc: The lexati has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing and sight.

traits.name: Wary Instinct (1/Day)
traits.desc: Once the lexati is engaged in combat. On its turn, Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 14, the lexati. Success: It Disengages from combat by leaping upwards and gliding away. The lexati doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it glides out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Vaulted Jump
traits.desc: The lexati can leap into the air 20 ft. and begin gliding. During this glide, it gains a flying speed of 40 ft., and can move 5 ft. horizontally for every 1 ft. it descends, and it can pass over other creatures and obstacles.

actions.name: Hooked Claws
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll : +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit : 5 (1d4+3) Slashing damage. If target is a Medium or smaller creature and the lexati glided a 20+ ft. straight toward the target immediately before the hit, the target takes an additional 4 (1d8) Slashing damage has the Prone condition.

reactions.name: Feline Finesse
reactions.desc: Trigger: A creature the lexati can see hits it with an attack roll. Response - Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15, the lexati. Success: The attack misses instead.

reactions.name: Wary Instinct Reaction
reactions.desc: Trigger: Once the lexati is engaged in combat. On its turn, Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 14, the lexati. Success: It Disengages from combat by leaping upwards and gliding away. The lexati doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it glides out of an enemy's reach.

name: Ricatrillisk
flavor:
A staccato of clicks can be heard in the canopy above, among the thick pine boughs of the colossal conifers that tower over the mountainous forests of Last Bloom and Amberdale. While they may look sinister in appearance, the ricatrillisk is nothing but benefi cial to the health of the Wealdwoods. Clinging to thick trunks it climbs upwards, sniffi ng out the rot and fungus that infects the oldest trees. Once it fi nds a sizable growth, it clings tightly to the wide trunk, munching through the tough exterior while its own chitinous hide protects it from aerial predators. Although a solitary fungivore, after mating season, its larvae will cling to the bodies of both male and female adults, as they clamber along the heights, depositing their young onto fungal growths to eat and grow as budding pupae.

Encountering Climbing to heights other creatures would have diffi culty reaching, the ricatrillisk is used to peaceful isolation. With little to lure the insect since its only interest is in the trees, this slow moving foliage-colored creature can be challenging to capture, but once found gripping tightly to the trunk, it's only a matter of fi nding a method to climb after it, or felling the tree.

bio.niche: Specialist Arboreal Fungivore Preyed upon by Basilospri, Jhotus, Sacrissian, Scavick, Skyelarx

traits.name: Wooden Stillness
traits.desc: While the ricatrillisk is gripping a tree, remaining motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal tree trunk. A creature within 30 ft. of the ricatrillisk can make a DC 12 Wisdom (Perception) check to discern whether they see the insect.

traits.name: Falling Strike
traits.desc: If the ricatrillisk surprises a creature and successfully hits it with an attack roll, the target takes an extra 2d4 Slashing damage.

traits.name: Adept Climber
traits.desc: The ricatrillisk can climb diffi cult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Resistances
traits.desc: Slashing

defensive_instinct: Defensive Instinct (1/Day) While slow to act, the ricatrillisk can summon great reserves of strength to weather any storm.

actions.name: Hooked Claws
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage.

reactions.name: Dorsal Shield
reactions.desc: Trigger: A creature the ricatrillisk can see hits it with an attack. Response - Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15, the ricatrillisk. Success: Halve the damage as the ricatrillisk turns and diverts the attack to its armored back.

reactions.name: Defensive Instinct Reaction
reactions.desc: Trigger: When the ricatrillisk is Bloodied. Response - Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14, the ricatrillisk. Success: The ricatrillisk gains +2 bonus to its Armor Class (total AC 17) for the duration of the combat encounter.

name: Aphistus
flavor:
Nestled between the wide expanse of the Grayfynn and the Stoanhall cliffs, a sanctuary of colossal trees form the Arborne woodlands. Under these immense canopies, deep sonorous bird song fi lls the air as a troop of aphistus birds rummage through the undergrowth, their long talons pulling aside heavy roots to expose the hard shelled nuts and terrestrial fruit that they crave. Th eir innate strength and ability to manipulate stubborn roots allows them to make durable nests of living woven roots, packing them with leaf litter to incubate their eggs while they venture out in search of food. Th ough generally peaceful creatures, a lifetime of pulling tough roots has bred them to be powerfully strong and when roused to defend their kin, their clawed strikes can tear through hide and shell with frightening ease.

Encountering Roaming along the forest ground in troops of a dozen kin, the aphistus can often be found by the sound of their deep melodious birdsong. While wary of strangers, they are generally confi dent in their size and strength to not initially flee. If approached slowly, especially when offering food, they will quickly calm and may investigate the curious newcomer to their woods.

A colorful crest acts as both a resonator for mating calls as well as a vibrant display for sexual maturity

Boros nut, a favorite of the avian herbivore since many other creatures cannot break its hard outer shell

bio.niche: Specialist Herbivore Preyed upon by Basilospri, Jhotus, Korrask, Nicalliath, Scavick, Skyelarx, Vinnirex

traits.name: Wealdborne Senses
traits.desc: The aphistus has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or smell.

traits.name: Rooted Strength
traits.desc: The aphistus has Advantage on all Strength (Athletics) rolls.

defensive_instinct: Defensive Instinct (1/Day) Charging in when its kin are in danger.

actions.name: Hooked Talons
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Crushing Beak
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Roll : +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Terrifi ed Caw
actions.desc: (Recharge 5-6) Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 30 ft. Cone. Failure: 13 (3d8) Thunder damage. Success: Half damage.

reactions.name: Kin Defense
reactions.desc: Trigger: A creature the aphistus can see hits an allied creature within 5 ft. of it with an attack roll. Response - Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 12, the triggering creature. Failure: The attack hits this aphistus instead.

reactions.name: Defensive Instinct Reaction

name: Basilospri
flavor: With a quick snap of its webbed wings the basilospri weaves among the colossal mountain forests canopy. Th is vicious flying lizard is unsuited for long periods of flight, but with its talon tipped phalanges it can pounce and pierce creatures in an instant, while still using the long digits to climb and cling to the immense trees in which it makes its home. Preferring tree dwelling prey, the basilospri is one of the few predators that can pierce the armored carapace of a ricatrillisk. Th ese lizards are highly territorial, and will defend their hunting grounds from their own kind in aggressive aerial disputes that often leave the defeated assailant's wings tattered to plummet to the forest floor. Leaving their broken rivals to the ground dwelling scavengers of the Wealdwoods to fi nish off.

name: Shaevrynn
flavor: Th ick clawed paws soundlessly step onto the exposed bark of a large Wealdwoods tree. A shifting blur of color and light ripples across the root, its form hard to perceive by most denizens of the woods. Hunting in the gloom of dusk, the waning sun plays tricks with shadows and light, enhancing the shaevrynn's already stealthy feline traits. Light-reflecting iridophores within the feline's quill-like fur, react automatically to the colors of the surrounding environment, while they lack any real precision, colors blend and bleed over the shifting fur like water, allowing the feline to stalk nearly invisibly. Th ese silent hunters are rarely seen and rarely caught, only their golden eyes, reflecting the light of the setting sun, betray their innate camouflage.

name: Ynnil
flavor: Scampering claws dig deep into the tree bark as the large lizard climbs higher, searching for a better vantage point. Within moments, a feathered blur passes the canopy clearing, and with instinctual precision, the ynill lets loose a stream of dark venom, blinding the hapless bird and dropping it down onto the trees below. Quickly, the ynill rushes across the branches to claim it before it falls to the floor below. Th ese ranged predators hunt alone once mature, spending most of their day basking in the sun above the canopy. When courting for prospective mates, the males can be found gripping the fragile branches of the tallest trees, spitting their stream of venom as high into the sky as possible, in an effort to impress the darker green females watching from behind the leaf cover.

name: Korrask
flavor: A multitude of articulated claws dig deep under root and soil as the korrask waits unseen beneath colossal Wealdwoods trees. Tunneling beneath tree roots is nearly impossible for most creatures, yet this great centipede is able to dig itself a burrow with shovel-like claws easily with its prodigious strength. When near the surface of well trod game trails, it pulls back its primary mandibles, tendons stretched taut, and its secondary jaws pull in detritus to cover its awaiting maw. With sensitive antennae questing out on the earth, the insect awaits the slightest vibrations of an incoming creature. As the unfortunate creature steps between the mandibles, they erupt from the earth violently with a fraction of a second, slicing the prey in half, before it pulls the grisly remains into its tooth-lined gullet.
